claims.statement: Anu, also called An, is an early Mesopotamian sky deity.
claims.statement_id: Anu atau An adalah dewa langit Mesopotamia awal.
claims.quote: Anu (also known as An) is an early Mesopotamian sky god

claims.statement: Anshar and Kishar are named as Anu’s parents.
claims.statement_id: Anshar dan Kishar disebut sebagai orang tua Anu.
claims.quote: He is the son of the couple Anshar and Kishar (heaven and earth, respectively)

claims.statement: Antu is identified as Anu’s consort.
claims.statement_id: Antu disebut sebagai pasangan Anu.
claims.quote: His consort is Antu (also known as Uras, goddess of the earth)

claims.statement: He is also described as Ki’s husband and the father of Enlil.
claims.statement_id: Versi lain menjadikan Ki pasangan Anu dan ibu Enlil.
claims.quote: He is also given as the husband of his sister Ki (earth), by whom his son Enlil is born.

claims.statement: A crown, sometimes placed on a throne, often represents Anu.
claims.statement_id: Anu sering dilambangkan mahkota atau mahkota di atas takhta.
claims.quote: Anu is most often represented in iconography simply by a crown or crown on a throne

claims.statement: Anu often appears as a background figure in myths.
claims.statement_id: Anu sering disebut sebagai tokoh latar dalam mitos.
claims.quote: he is often mentioned as a background figure

claims.statement: Anu forms a divine triad with Enlil and Enki.
claims.statement_id: Anu, Enlil, dan Enki membentuk kelompok tiga dewa.
claims.quote: Along with Enlil and Enki, Anu formed a triad

claims.statement: The Sumerian name An is explained as meaning sky.
claims.statement_id: Nama Sumeria An dijelaskan berarti langit.
claims.quote: He was originally a Sumerian sky deity known as An (meaning "sky")

claims.statement: Sargon’s inscriptions invoke Anu and Inanna as legitimizing his rule.
claims.statement_id: Prasasti Sargon menyebut Anu dan Inanna sebagai pemberi legitimasi pemerintahannya.
claims.quote: Sargon the Great of Akkad (reign 2334-2279 BCE) mentions Anu and Inanna in his inscriptions as legitimizing his rule

claims.statement: In the creation story, Anu offers to negotiate with Tiamat.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah penciptaan, Anu menawarkan upaya diplomasi kepada Tiamat.
claims.quote: At this point, Anu volunteers to go speak with Tiamat and try to resolve the problem diplomatically.

claims.statement: In the Adapa myth, Anu summons Adapa for an explanation.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitos Adapa, Anu memanggil Adapa untuk memberikan penjelasan.
claims.quote: News of this soon reaches Anu, who summons Adapa to him to explain.

claims.statement: Anu is described as holding the Tablets of Destiny before passing them to Enlil.
claims.statement_id: Anu digambarkan memegang Lauh Takdir sebelum menyerahkannya kepada Enlil.
claims.quote: Anu is the first to hold the Tablets of Destiny before passing them on to Enlil.

claims.statement: During storms Anu is imagined as a great bull roaring above the clouds.
claims.statement_id: Saat badai, Anu dibayangkan sebagai banteng besar yang mengaum di atas awan.
claims.quote: During storms he was imagined as a great bull roaring above the clouds.

claims.statement: Mackenzie’s retelling describes Anu obeying Anshar’s commands.
claims.statement_id: Penceritaan Mackenzie menggambarkan Anu mematuhi perintah Anshar.
claims.quote: Anu was obedient to the commands of Anshar.

claims.statement: That retelling says Anu fears approaching Tiamat and turns back.
claims.statement_id: Penceritaan itu menyebut Anu takut mendekati Tiamat dan kembali.
claims.quote: but he feared to approach her, and turned back.
