claims.statement: Enlil, also called Ellil and Nunamnir, is the Sumerian god of air.
claims.statement_id: Enlil, juga disebut Ellil dan Nunamnir, adalah dewa udara Sumeria.
claims.quote: Enlil (also known as Ellil and Nunamnir) was the Sumerian god of the air in the Mesopotamian pantheon

claims.statement: Enlil is identified as Anu’s son.
claims.statement_id: Enlil disebut sebagai putra Anu.
claims.quote: He was the son of the god of the heavens, Anu (also known as An)

claims.statement: Another version names Enki and Ninki, Lord and Lady Earth, distinct from the wisdom god, as his parents.
claims.statement_id: Versi lain menyebut orang tuanya Enki dan Ninki, pasangan Bumi yang berbeda dari Enki dewa kebijaksanaan.
claims.quote: Enlil is also sometimes referred to as the son of Enki and Ninki (Lord and Lady Earth, and not Enki, the god of wisdom)

claims.statement: Enlil’s name is translated as Lord of Air.
claims.statement_id: Nama Enlil diterjemahkan sebagai Penguasa Udara.
claims.quote: Although his name translates as "Lord of Air,"

claims.statement: Nippur houses Enlil’s central sanctuary, called the Mountain House.
claims.statement_id: Nippur menjadi pusat pemujaan Enlil di kuil yang disebut Rumah Gunung.
claims.quote: The city of Nippur was the central seat of Enlil's worship at the temple/ziggurat known as "the Mountain House"

claims.statement: Nuska, Enlil’s son, is described as his assistant.
claims.statement_id: Nuska, putra Enlil, dijelaskan sebagai pembantunya.
claims.quote: His executive assistant was his son Nuska.

claims.statement: Ninlil, also called Sud, is Enlil’s wife.
claims.statement_id: Ninlil, yang juga disebut Sud, adalah pasangan Enlil.
claims.quote: Enlil/Ellil was a family man, married to Ninlil (also called Sud)

claims.statement: The myths discussed identify Ninurta as the son of Ninhursag and Enlil.
claims.statement_id: Mitos yang dibahas menyebut Ninurta sebagai putra Ninhursag dan Enlil.
claims.quote: he is the son of Ninhursag and Enlil.

claims.statement: Enlil’s worship is traced to Early Dynastic Period I.
claims.statement_id: Pemujaan Enlil ditelusuri hingga Periode Dinasti Awal I.
claims.quote: Worship of Enlil dates from the Early Dynastic Period I

claims.statement: Enlil guards the Tablets of Destiny containing the fates of gods and humanity.
claims.statement_id: Enlil menjaga Lauh Takdir yang memuat nasib dewa dan manusia.
claims.quote: keeper of the Tablets of Destiny, which contained the fates of gods and humanity

claims.statement: In the Zu story, the bird steals Enlil’s Tablet and flies into the mountains.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Zu, burung itu mencuri Lauh dari Enlil dan terbang ke pegunungan.
claims.quote: Zu snatched the Tablet from him and flew away with it into the mountains.

claims.statement: In Enlil and Ninlil, Enlil disguises himself as the figures he encounters.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Enlil dan Ninlil, Enlil menyamar sebagai tokoh-tokoh yang ditemuinya.
claims.quote: He then disguises himself as each one

claims.statement: Worshippers ask Enlil for favorable weather and harvests.
claims.statement_id: Enlil dimohonkan cuaca baik demi hasil panen.
claims.quote: Enlil was an important weather god often prayed to and worshipped in hopes of fair weather for a good harvest.

claims.statement: Enlil belongs to a triad with Anu and Enki.
claims.statement_id: Enlil membentuk triad bersama Anu dan Enki.
claims.quote: Enlil, Anu, and Enki made up a triad

claims.statement: The Descent of Inanna instructs Ninshubur to lament before Enlil at Ekur.
claims.statement_id: Dalam teks Turunnya Inanna, Ninshubur diperintahkan meratap kepada Enlil di Ekur.
claims.quote: When you have entered the E-kur, the house of Enlil, lament before Enlil

claims.statement: Sin, also known as Nanna, is the Mesopotamian deity of the moon and wisdom.
claims.statement_id: Sin atau Nanna adalah dewa bulan dan kebijaksanaan Mesopotamia.
claims.quote: Nanna (also known as Nannar, Nanna-Suen, Sin, Asimbabbar, Namrasit, Inbu) is the Mesopotamian god of the moon and wisdom.

claims.statement: Nanna is his Sumerian name; Sin and Nanna-Suen are alternative names.
claims.statement_id: Nanna merupakan nama Sumerianya, sedangkan Sin dan Nanna-Suen adalah nama lainnya.
claims.quote: Nanna was his Sumerian name, while he was known as Sin, Nanna-Sin, Nanna-Suen

claims.statement: His major cult center is the temple and ziggurat at Ur.
claims.statement_id: Kuil dan ziggurat di Ur menjadi pusat pemujaannya.
claims.quote: His cult center was the great temple and ziggurat at the Sumerian city of Ur

claims.statement: Sin is identified as the son of Enlil and Ninlil.
claims.statement_id: Sin disebut sebagai putra Enlil dan Ninlil.
claims.quote: He was the son of Enlil and Ninlil

claims.statement: Ningal, also called Nikkal, is his wife and a fertility goddess.
claims.statement_id: Ningal atau Nikkal, dewi kesuburan, disebut sebagai istrinya.
claims.quote: His wife was Ningal (also Nikkal, the "Great Lady"), a fertility goddess

claims.statement: Utu-Shamash is named as the couple’s son.
claims.statement_id: Utu-Shamash disebut sebagai putra pasangan itu.
claims.quote: their children were Utu-Shamash (the sun god)

claims.statement: Sin also has an important temple at Harran.
claims.statement_id: Sin juga memiliki kuil penting di Harran.
claims.quote: he also had an important temple at Harran

claims.statement: One depiction shows a seated man with a lapis-lazuli beard and a crescent above him.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu penggambaran menunjukkan pria duduk berjanggut lapis lazuli dengan bulan sabit di atasnya.
claims.quote: a seated man with a long beard of lapis lazuli, a crescent moon above him

claims.statement: The number 30 represents him through the days of a lunar month.
claims.statement_id: Angka 30 melambangkannya dengan merujuk jumlah hari bulan lunar.
claims.quote: he is represented simply by the number 30, referring to the number of days in a lunar month

claims.statement: At the new moon, Sin is said to judge the dead in the netherworld.
claims.statement_id: Pada bulan baru, Sin dikatakan berada di dunia bawah untuk mengadili orang mati.
claims.quote: the god was said to be in the netherworld, where he judged the dead.

claims.statement: In The Journey of Nanna to Nippur, he loads offerings at Ur to bring to Enlil.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Perjalanan Nanna ke Nippur, ia membawa muatan persembahan dari Ur kepada Enlil.
claims.quote: The Journey of Nanna to Nippur, the god is seen loading his boat at Ur with all good things to present to his father Enlil at the city of Nippur.

claims.statement: Enheduanna is identified as his best-known high priestess.
claims.statement_id: Enheduanna disebut sebagai pendeta tingginya yang paling terkenal.
claims.quote: his most famous high priestess was Enheduanna

claims.statement: Sin is associated with the fertility of women and cattle.
claims.statement_id: Sin dihubungkan dengan kesuburan perempuan dan ternak.
claims.quote: Sin was associated with the fertility of women and cattle.

claims.statement: The accompanying source depicts him as a standing man with a crescent moon.
claims.statement_id: Sumber pendamping menggambarkannya sebagai pria berdiri dengan bulan sabit.
claims.quote: He is depicted as a man standing with a crescent moon.

claims.statement: In the Descent of Inanna, Nanna is a recipient of Ninshubur’s appeal at Urim.
claims.statement_id: Dalam teks Turunnya Inanna, Nanna menjadi tujuan permohonan Ninshubur di Urim.
claims.quote: In the E-mud-kura at Urim, when you have entered the E-kic-nu-jal, the house of Nanna, lament before Nanna

claims.statement: Inanna is a Sumerian goddess associated with love, fertility, procreation, and war.
claims.statement_id: Inanna adalah dewi Sumeria yang dihubungkan dengan cinta, kesuburan, kelahiran, dan perang.
claims.quote: Inanna is the ancient Sumerian goddess of love, sensuality, fertility, procreation, and also of war.

claims.statement: Akkadian and Assyrian traditions later identify her with Ishtar.
claims.statement_id: Bangsa Akkadia dan Asyur kemudian mengidentifikasinya dengan Ishtar.
claims.quote: She later became identified by the Akkadians and Assyrians as the goddess Ishtar

claims.statement: Inanna is associated with Venus as the morning and evening star.
claims.statement_id: Inanna dikaitkan dengan Venus sebagai bintang pagi dan petang.
claims.quote: She was also seen as the bright star of the morning and evening, Venus

claims.statement: Inanna serves as the patron goddess of Uruk.
claims.statement_id: Inanna menjadi dewi pelindung Uruk.
claims.quote: Inanna was the foremost Sumerian goddess, patron deity of Uruk.

claims.statement: Eanna at Uruk is her principal sanctuary.
claims.statement_id: Eanna di Uruk menjadi kuil utamanya.
claims.quote: Inanna's main sanctuary was the Eanna ('House of Heaven') at Uruk

claims.statement: Some myths identify Inanna as Enki’s daughter.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian mitos menyebut Inanna sebagai putri Enki.
claims.quote: she is the daughter of Enki, the god of wisdom

claims.statement: Other myths identify Inanna as Nanna’s daughter.
claims.statement_id: Mitos lain menyebut Inanna sebagai putri Nanna.
claims.quote: she appears as the daughter of Nanna, god of the moon and wisdom

claims.statement: The poet and priestess Enheduanna contributes to Inanna’s growing prominence.
claims.statement_id: Karya penyair dan pendeta Enheduanna berperan dalam berkembangnya kedudukan Inanna.
claims.quote: Through the work of the Akkadian poet and high priestess Enheduanna

claims.statement: Her written name uses a sign depicting a reed stalk looped at the top.
claims.statement_id: Tulisan namanya memakai lambang batang buluh berlingkar pada ujungnya.
claims.quote: Her name was written with a sign that represents a reed stalk tied into a loop at the top.

claims.statement: She is often shown with a lion, described as signifying courage.
claims.statement_id: Ia sering ditampilkan bersama singa, yang dijelaskan sebagai lambang keberanian.
claims.quote: She is often shown in the company of a lion, denoting courage

claims.statement: As a war goddess, Inanna is depicted in armor and battle dress.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran Inanna sebagai dewi perang memakai baju tempur.
claims.quote: In her aspect as goddess of war, Inanna is depicted in the armor of a male, in battle dress

claims.statement: Jeremy Black’s account distinguishes Inanna from marriage goddesses and mother goddesses.
claims.statement_id: Uraian Jeremy Black membedakan Inanna dari dewi perkawinan dan dewi ibu.
claims.quote: Inanna is not a goddess of marriage, nor is she a mother goddess.

claims.statement: The Descent of Inanna describes her abandoning heaven and earth for the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Teks Turunnya Inanna mengisahkan ia meninggalkan langit dan bumi menuju dunia bawah.
claims.quote: Inana abandoned heaven, abandoned earth, and descended to the underworld.

claims.statement: Her minister Ninshubur follows Inanna on that journey.
claims.statement_id: Ninshubur mengikuti Inanna dalam perjalanan itu.
claims.quote: Her minister Nincubura travelled behind her.

claims.statement: In that text, Inanna says Enki knows the life-giving plant and water.
claims.statement_id: Dalam teks itu, Inanna menyebut Enki mengetahui tumbuhan dan air pemberi kehidupan.
claims.quote: Father Enki, the lord of great wisdom, knows about the life-giving plant and the life-giving water.

claims.statement: Dumuzid is identified as Inanna’s husband.
claims.statement_id: Dumuzid disebut sebagai suami Inanna.
claims.quote: Her husband is the god Dumuzid

claims.statement: Ishtar is a major Mesopotamian goddess of love and war, called Inanna in Sumerian sources.
claims.statement_id: Ishtar adalah dewi utama Mesopotamia yang dikaitkan dengan cinta dan perang; sumber Sumeria menyebutnya Inanna.
claims.quote: Ishtar (Inanna in Sumerian sources) is a primary Mesopotamian goddess closely associated with love and war.

claims.statement: Her cult is attested at Uruk from the late fourth millennium BCE.
claims.statement_id: Kultusnya tercatat di Uruk sejak akhir milenium keempat SM.
claims.quote: her cult attested at Uruk as early as the late 4th millennium BCE.

claims.statement: Sumerian love poetry depicts her living with her mother Ningal and father Nanna.
claims.statement_id: Puisi cinta Sumeria menggambarkannya tinggal bersama ibu Ningal dan ayah Nanna.
claims.quote: she is depicted as a young woman who lives at home with her mother, Ningal, and her father, Nanna

claims.statement: Utu, known as Shamash in Semitic sources, is her twin brother.
claims.statement_id: Utu atau Shamash disebut sebagai saudara kembarnya.
claims.quote: Her twin brother is Utu (Semitic Shamash), the solar deity

claims.statement: Venus, the morning and evening star, is associated with Ishtar.
claims.statement_id: Venus, bintang pagi dan petang, menjadi benda langit yang dihubungkan dengan Ishtar.
claims.quote: Venus, the morning and evening star.

claims.statement: Dumuzi, or Tammuz, is Ishtar’s partner and appears as a shepherd king.
claims.statement_id: Dumuzi atau Tammuz menjadi pasangan Ishtar dan tampil sebagai raja gembala.
claims.quote: The goddess's courting partner is Dumuzi (Semitic Tammuz), who appears in myths as a shepherd king.

claims.statement: The source assesses Ishtar as influencing the images and cults of later goddesses.
claims.statement_id: Sumber menilai Ishtar memengaruhi gambaran dan kultus sejumlah dewi berikutnya.
claims.quote: Ishtar had a significant impact on the images and cults of many later goddesses

claims.statement: In the Standard Babylonian Epic of Gilgamesh, Ishtar appears most prominently in Tablet VI.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi Babilonia standar Epos Gilgamesh, Ishtar terutama tampil pada Lauh VI.
claims.quote: In the Standard Babylonian Version of the Epic of Gilgamesh, Ishtar appears most prominently in Tablet VI.

claims.statement: In that story, Ishtar proposes marriage to Gilgamesh and offers inducements.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah itu, Ishtar melamar Gilgamesh dengan menawarkan imbalan.
claims.quote: She proposes marriage and offers some nice inducements to sweeten the deal.

claims.statement: Gilgamesh refuses, comparing her to a drafty door and a faulty battering ram.
claims.statement_id: Gilgamesh menolak sambil membandingkannya dengan pintu berangin dan alat pendobrak yang rusak.
claims.quote: Gilgamesh compares the goddess to a drafty back door, a faulty battering ram

claims.statement: After the rejection, Ishtar visits the sky god Anu.
claims.statement_id: Setelah penolakan itu, Ishtar mengunjungi dewa langit Anu.
claims.quote: She travels to the heavens to visit the sky deity, Anu.

claims.statement: Ishtar persuades Anu to lend her the Bull of Heaven.
claims.statement_id: Ishtar membujuk Anu agar meminjamkan Banteng Langit.
claims.quote: the goddess persuades the elder god to loan her the Bull of Heaven.

claims.statement: Gilgamesh and Enkidu kill the bull, and Ishtar mourns its body with the city’s women.
claims.statement_id: Gilgamesh dan Enkidu membunuh banteng; Ishtar meratapi tubuhnya bersama perempuan kota.
claims.quote: The two heroes are able to kill the great beast, and Ishtar mourns over its body with the women of the city.

claims.statement: The Sumerian text about Inanna, Ishtar’s counterpart, recounts the goddess descending to the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Teks Sumeria tentang Inanna, padanan Ishtar, mengisahkan perjalanan dewi ke dunia bawah.
claims.quote: My mistress abandoned heaven, abandoned earth, and descended to the underworld.

claims.statement: The Eanna temple at Uruk is this goddess’s principal cult center.
claims.statement_id: Kuil Eanna di Uruk merupakan pusat utama pemujaan dewi ini.
claims.quote: She was the patron goddess of the Eanna temple at the city of Uruk

claims.statement: Sumerian tradition associates Enki, also named Ea, with wisdom, intelligence, and freshwater.
claims.statement_id: Enki atau Ea adalah dewa kebijaksanaan, air tawar, dan kecerdasan Sumeria.
claims.quote: Enki (also known as Ea, Enkig, Dis, Nagbu, Nissiku Nudimmud) was the Sumerian god of wisdom, freshwater, intelligence

claims.statement: Images show Enki with a beard, long robes, and a cap bearing horns.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran Enki menunjukkan pria berjanggut dengan tutup kepala bertanduk dan jubah panjang.
claims.quote: Iconography depicts him as a bearded man wearing a horned cap and long robes

claims.statement: Streams of water are depicted flowing from Enki’s shoulders.
claims.statement_id: Aliran air digambarkan keluar dari bahu Enki.
claims.quote: flowing streams run from his shoulders

claims.statement: Enki’s name is interpreted as Lord of the Earth.
claims.statement_id: Nama Enki diartikan sebagai Penguasa Bumi.
claims.quote: His name means "Lord of the Earth,"

claims.statement: Fish and goats are Enki’s symbols, explained as representing fertility.
claims.statement_id: Ikan dan kambing menjadi simbol Enki yang dijelaskan sebagai lambang kesuburan.
claims.quote: his symbols are the fish and the goat, both representations of fertility

claims.statement: Enki protects Eridu, regarded as the first established city.
claims.statement_id: Enki menjadi pelindung Eridu, kota yang dianggap pertama didirikan.
claims.quote: patron of the city of Eridu, considered by the Mesopotamians the first city established

claims.statement: Written references to Enki are traced to Early Dynastic Period III.
claims.statement_id: Catatan tertulisnya ditelusuri ke Periode Dinasti Awal III.
claims.quote: The god first appears in written works during the Early Dynastic period III (2600-2334 BCE)

claims.statement: Sumerian and Akkadian mythology identifies Anu as Enki’s father.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Sumeria dan Akkadia, Anu disebut sebagai ayah Enki.
claims.quote: Enki was the son of Anu, the sky god, in Sumerian and Akkadian mythology

claims.statement: Babylonian texts identify Enki as Apsu’s son.
claims.statement_id: Teks Babilonia menyebut Enki sebagai putra Apsu.
claims.quote: the son of Apsu, the primordial father, in Babylonian texts.

claims.statement: Enki is also referred to as the goddess Nammu’s son.
claims.statement_id: Versi lain menyebut Nammu sebagai ibunya.
claims.quote: He is also referred to as the son of the goddess Nammu

claims.statement: Enki forms an early Mesopotamian triad with Anu and Enlil.
claims.statement_id: Enki membentuk triad Mesopotamia bersama Anu dan Enlil.
claims.quote: Along with Anu and Enlil, Enki made up an early Mesopotamian triad

claims.statement: In the Enuma Elish, Enki puts his father into a deep sleep before killing him.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Enuma Elish, Enki menidurkan ayahnya sebelum membunuhnya.
claims.quote: he put his father into a deep sleep and then killed him.

claims.statement: In the Descent of Inanna, the goddess trusts Enki to restore her to life.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Turunnya Inanna, dewi itu mempercayai Enki dapat menghidupkannya kembali.
claims.quote: He is the one who will restore me to life.

claims.statement: Damgalnuna is identified as Enki’s wife.
claims.statement_id: Damgalnuna disebut sebagai istri Enki.
claims.quote: Enki's wife was Damgalnuna, and their children included Nanshe

claims.statement: Enki’s primary symbols include the goat-fish, a ram-headed staff, and the turtle.
claims.statement_id: Kambing-ikan, tongkat berkepala domba, dan kura-kura adalah simbol Enki.
claims.quote: Enki/Ea's primary symbols included the goat-fish, the ram-headed staff and the turtle.

claims.statement: In this article's account of the Atrahasis, Enki sees the flood plan as cruel and unjust but cannot deter Enlil, so he finds Atrahasis, an honest man devoted to him.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, dalam Atrahasis Enki menilai rencana banjir itu kejam dan tidak adil tetapi tidak dapat mencegah Enlil, lalu mencari Atrahasis, orang jujur yang saleh kepadanya.
claims.quote: Enki recognizes the cruelty and injustice of this plan but cannot deter Enlil, so he goes to earth and finds an honest man, Atrahasis, one who has always been both wise and kind and has devoted himself to Enki piously.

claims.statement: Enki whispers to Atrahasis to build an ark and enter it with two of every kind of animal.
claims.statement_id: Enki membisikkan kepada Atrahasis agar membangun bahtera dan masuk bersama sepasang dari setiap jenis hewan.
claims.quote: Enki whispers to him to build an ark and enter it with two of every kind of animal.

claims.statement: When Enlil sends drought, pestilence and then famine, people appeal to Enki, who first conceived them, and he helps by telling them what to do.
claims.statement_id: Ketika Enlil mengirim kekeringan, wabah, lalu kelaparan, manusia berseru kepada Enki, dewa yang pertama memikirkan mereka, dan Enki menolong dengan memberi tahu apa yang harus mereka lakukan.
claims.quote: He sends a drought, then pestilence, then famine, and each time the people appeal to their father-god Enki, the one who first conceived of them, and he helps them by telling them what they should do

claims.statement: In the Atrahasis, Enki proposes that lesser beings be created to work alongside the gods.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Atrahasis, Enki mengusulkan agar dicipta makhluk yang lebih rendah untuk menjadi rekan kerja para dewa muda.
claims.quote: so Enki proposes that they create lesser beings who will be co-workers with them.

claims.statement: In Inanna and the God of Wisdom, Enki holds the meh, the laws and powers over all of life and the gifts of civilization that belong to the gods alone, and lets Inanna take them at a drunken party.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Inanna dan Dewa Kebijaksanaan, Enki memegang meh, hukum dan kuasa atas seluruh kehidupan serta karunia peradaban yang hanya milik para dewa, dan ia membiarkan Inanna mengambilnya saat pesta mabuk.
claims.quote: He is shown in the story Inanna and the God of Wisdom as possessor of the meh, the laws and powers concerned with all of life and the gifts of civilization – the possessions of the gods alone – which he allows Inanna to take from him during a drunken party.

claims.statement: In the Sumerian text Enki and Ninmah, Namma asks her son Enki to use the skill of his wisdom to create a substitute for the gods so they can be freed from toil.
claims.statement_id: Dalam teks Sumeria Enki dan Ninmah, Namma meminta putranya Enki memakai keahlian dari kebijaksanaannya untuk menciptakan pengganti bagi para dewa agar mereka bebas dari kerja berat.
claims.quote: Please apply the skill deriving from your wisdom and create a substitute (?) for the gods so that they can be freed from their toil!

claims.statement: Enki tells Namma to knead clay from the top of the abzu so that the planned creature's form will come into being.
claims.statement_id: Enki menyuruh Namma mengaduk tanah liat dari atas abzu agar bentuk makhluk yang direncanakan itu tercipta.
claims.quote: You should knead clay from the top of the abzu; the birth-goddesses (?) will nip off the clay and you shall bring the form into existence.

claims.statement: The senior gods praise Enki as the one who holds the me of deciding destinies, even saying he is the me itself.
claims.statement_id: Para dewa senior memuji Enki sebagai pemilik me untuk menentukan nasib, bahkan menyebutnya sebagai me itu sendiri.
claims.quote: Like a corporeal father, you are the one who has the me of deciding destinies, in fact you are the me.

claims.statement: Enki declares that he will counterbalance whatever fate, good or bad, Ninmah decides.
claims.statement_id: Enki menyatakan akan mengimbangi nasib apa pun, baik atau buruk, yang ditetapkan Ninmah.
claims.quote: I will counterbalance whatever fate -- good or bad -- you happen to decide.

claims.statement: Enki bathes one of Ninmah's creatures in enchanted water and drives the namtar demon out of his body.
claims.statement_id: Enki memandikan seorang makhluk ciptaan Ninmah dengan air terpesona dan mengusir iblis namtar dari tubuhnya.
claims.quote: Enki looked at the one who could not hold back his urine and bathed him in enchanted water and drove out the namtar demon from his body.

claims.statement: In the Sumerian hymn, a single glance from Enki is enough to unsettle the heart of the mountains.
claims.statement_id: Dalam puji-pujian Sumeria, satu pandangan Enki cukup mengguncang hati pegunungan.
claims.quote: Enki, from whom a single glance is enough to unsettle the heart of the mountains;

claims.statement: Enki need only open his mouth for everything to multiply and for plenty to be established.
claims.statement_id: Cukup dengan membuka mulut, Enki membuat segala sesuatu berlipat ganda dan kelimpahan terwujud.
claims.quote: You have only to open your mouth for everything to multiply and for plenty to be established.

claims.statement: In his self-praise Enki says that at his command folds and pens were built, and when he approaches heaven abundant rain falls and when he approaches earth there is a high carp-flood.
claims.statement_id: Dalam pujian dirinya, Enki berkata bahwa atas perintahnya kandang dibangun, dan ketika ia mendekati langit turun hujan kelimpahan, ketika ia mendekati bumi terjadi banjir ikan karper yang tinggi.
claims.quote: At my command, sheepfolds have been built, cow-pens have been fenced off. When I approach heaven, a rain of abundance rains from heaven. When I approach earth, there is a high carp-flood.

claims.statement: Enki says his elder brother gathered all the divine powers and placed them in his hand, and that he brought the arts and crafts from the E-kur, house of Enlil, to his Abzu in Eridug.
claims.statement_id: Enki berkata bahwa kakaknya mengumpulkan semua kuasa ilahi dan menaruhnya di tangannya, dan bahwa ia membawa seni dan kerajinan dari E-kur rumah Enlil ke Abzu-nya di Eridug.
claims.quote: My elder brother, the king of all the lands, gathered up all the divine powers and placed them in my hand. I brought the arts and crafts from the E-kur, the house of Enlil, to my Abzu in Eridug.

claims.statement: Enki says that with An he oversees justice and with Enlil he decrees good destinies over the lands.
claims.statement_id: Enki berkata bahwa bersama An ia mengawasi keadilan, dan bersama Enlil ia menetapkan nasib yang baik atas negeri-negeri.
claims.quote: With An the king, on An's dais, I oversee justice. With Enlil, looking out over the lands, I decree good destinies.

claims.statement: Enki presented animals to those with no city and no houses, the Martu nomads.
claims.statement_id: Enki memberikan hewan kepada mereka yang tidak punya kota dan rumah, yaitu para pengembara Martu.
claims.quote: He presented animals to those who have no city, to those who have no houses, to the Martu nomads.

claims.statement: Cybele, or Kybele, is the Phrygian Mother of the Gods and a primal nature goddess.
claims.statement_id: Cybele atau Kybele adalah Ibu Para Dewa Frigia dan dewi alam purba.
claims.quote: KYBELE (Cybele) was the ancient Phrygian Mother of the Gods, a primal nature goddess

claims.statement: Cybele is also known as the Great Mother or Magna Mater.
claims.statement_id: Cybele juga disebut Ibu Agung atau Magna Mater.
claims.quote: Known as the Great Mother or Magna Mater

claims.statement: Pessinus is the location of Cybele’s chief sanctuary.
claims.statement_id: Pessinus menjadi lokasi kuil utama Cybele.
claims.quote: Cybele, whose chief sanctuary was at Pessinus

claims.statement: The source traces her appearance in Greece to the fifth century BCE, with a temple at Athens.
claims.statement_id: Sumber menelusuri kemunculannya di Yunani pada abad kelima SM dengan kuil di Athena.
claims.quote: she made her initial appearance in Greece in the 5th century BCE with a temple in Athens

claims.statement: A black meteorite representing Cybele is brought to Rome in 204 BCE.
claims.statement_id: Batu meteor hitam yang mewakili Cybele dibawa ke Roma pada 204 SM.
claims.quote: A black meteorite, representing the goddess, was brought to Rome from Asia Minor in 204 BCE.

claims.statement: A temple honoring Cybele is built on the Palatine Hill in 191 BCE.
claims.statement_id: Kuil Cybele dibangun di Bukit Palatine pada 191 SM.
claims.quote: a temple honoring Cybele would be built on Palatine Hill in 191 BCE.

claims.statement: Cybele’s lion companion symbolizes her role as mistress of wild nature.
claims.statement_id: Singa pendamping Cybele melambangkan kedudukannya sebagai penguasa alam liar.
claims.quote: She was the mistress of wild nature, symbolized by her constant companion, the lion.

claims.statement: Cybele is believed both to cure and to cause disease.
claims.statement_id: Cybele dipercaya dapat menyembuhkan sekaligus menyebabkan penyakit.
claims.quote: she both cured and caused disease

claims.statement: Statues show Cybele in a lion-drawn chariot or enthroned with a bowl, drum, and mural crown.
claims.statement_id: Patungnya memperlihatkan kereta bersinga atau takhta, mangkuk, genderang, dan mahkota berbentuk tembok.
claims.quote: either on a chariot pulled by lions or enthroned carrying a bowl and drum, wearing a mural crown, flanked by lions

claims.statement: Attis is described as Cybele’s lover, while other sources make him her son.
claims.statement_id: Attis disebut sebagai kekasih Cybele, sementara sumber lain menjadikannya putra Cybele.
claims.quote: Supposedly, Attis was Cybele's lover, although some sources claim him to be her son.

claims.statement: In the summarized story, Attis falls in love with a mortal and chooses to marry.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah yang diringkas, Attis jatuh cinta kepada seorang manusia dan memilih menikah.
claims.quote: he fell in love with a mortal and chose to marry.

claims.statement: An angry Cybele causes panic among the guests at Attis’s wedding.
claims.statement_id: Cybele yang marah menimbulkan kepanikan pada tamu pernikahan Attis.
claims.quote: the irate and jealous goddess apparently struck panic into those who attended the wedding.

claims.statement: Her cult festival includes public games and a theatrical performance at Circus Maximus.
claims.statement_id: Perayaan kultusnya mencakup permainan umum dan pertunjukan teater di Circus Maximus.
claims.quote: The festival included public games as well as a theatrical performance at Circus Maximus.

claims.statement: Cybele’s cult continues until the fourth century CE.
claims.statement_id: Kultus Cybele bertahan hingga abad keempat Masehi.
claims.quote: The Cult of Cybele lasted until the 4th century CE

claims.statement: Greek tradition worships Cybele as Mother of the Gods.
claims.statement_id: Tradisi Yunani memuja Kibele sebagai Ibu Para Dewa.
claims.quote: Penduduk Yunani Kuno menjadikan Kibele sebagai ibu dari para dewa.

claims.statement: Mitra is an Indo-Iranian divine name connected with Rigvedic Mitra and Avestan Mithra.
claims.statement_id: Mitra adalah nama ilahi Indo-Iran yang terkait dengan Mitra Rigveda dan Mithra Avesta.
claims.quote: Mitra (Proto-Indo-Iranian: *mitrás) is the name of an Indo-Iranian divinity that came out of the Rigvedic Mitrá and Avestan Mithra.

claims.statement: Avestan miθra preserves the meaning covenant.
claims.statement_id: Bahasa Avesta mempertahankan makna perjanjian untuk miθra.
claims.quote: This meaning is preserved in Avestan miθra "covenant".

claims.statement: In Sanskrit and modern Indo-Aryan languages, mitra means friend.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Sanskerta dan Indo-Arya modern, mitra berarti sahabat.
claims.quote: In Sanskrit and modern Indo-Aryan languages, mitra means "friend"

claims.statement: Persian tradition associates Mithra with the rising sun, contracts, covenants, and friendship.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi Persia, Mithra dihubungkan dengan matahari terbit, perjanjian, dan persahabatan.
claims.quote: Mithra is the Persian god of the rising sun, contracts, covenants, and friendship.

claims.statement: The source distinguishes Persian Mithra from the Mithras of the Roman mystery cult.
claims.statement_id: Sumber membedakan Mithra Persia dari Mithras kultus misteri Romawi.
claims.quote: these are two different deities, although Mithras is loosely derived from Mithra.

claims.statement: Vedic Mitra is associated with contracts, sunrise, harvest fertility, and truth.
claims.statement_id: Mitra Weda dihubungkan dengan perjanjian, fajar, kesuburan panen, dan kebenaran.
claims.quote: The Vedic Mitra (sometimes given as Mitra-Varuna) was the god of contracts and the sunrise, fertility in the form of rain and good harvests, and keeper of truth.

claims.statement: The Mitra-Varuna pairing connects Mitra with the sky god Varuna.
claims.statement_id: Pasangan Mitra-Varuna menghubungkan Mitra dengan dewa langit Varuna.
claims.quote: The Mitra-Varuna coupling joined the god of the sunrise with the powerful sky god Varuna

claims.statement: Persian Mithra rides a bright chariot drawn by white horses.
claims.statement_id: Mithra Persia digambarkan menaiki kereta bercahaya yang ditarik kuda putih.
claims.quote: He rides in a bright chariot drawn by white horses

claims.statement: His weapons include a silver spear, a bow and golden arrows, daggers, axes, and a mace.
claims.statement_id: Persenjatannya mencakup tombak perak, busur dan anak panah emas, pisau, kapak, serta gada.
claims.quote: armed with a silver spear, a bow and arrows of gold, daggers, axes, and the mace

claims.statement: Mithra bestows farr, divine grace, on a worthy monarch.
claims.statement_id: Mithra memberikan farr atau karunia ilahi kepada raja yang layak.
claims.quote: bestowing the farr (divine grace) on a worthy monarch

claims.statement: Mithra’s name is invoked in Achaemenid inscriptions.
claims.statement_id: Nama Mithra dipanggil dalam prasasti Kekaisaran Akhemeniyah.
claims.quote: Mithra's name was invoked in inscriptions during the Achaemenid Empire

claims.statement: The Mihr Yasht says Mithra stands for both the faithful and the unfaithful in contracts.
claims.statement_id: Mihr Yasht menyebut Mithra membela pihak seiman maupun yang berbeda iman dalam perjanjian.
claims.quote: For Mithra stands for both the faithful and the unfaithful.

claims.statement: The Mihr Yasht attributes swiftness for horses to Mithra.
claims.statement_id: Mihr Yasht menyebut Mithra memberikan kecepatan kepada kuda.
claims.quote: Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, gives swiftness to the horses

claims.statement: The hymn depicts Mithra with a thousand ears and ten thousand eyes.
claims.statement_id: Himne menggambarkan Mithra memiliki seribu telinga dan sepuluh ribu mata.
claims.quote: with a thousand ears, well-shapen, with ten thousand eyes

claims.statement: Mithra is praised as strong, sleepless, and always awake.
claims.statement_id: Mithra dipuji sebagai kuat, tidak tidur, dan selalu terjaga.
claims.quote: strong, sleepless, and ever awake

claims.statement: Ahriman is an evil spirit in Iranian tradition, Zoroastrianism, and Zurvanism, associated with darkness and chaos.
claims.statement_id: Ahriman adalah roh jahat dalam tradisi Iran, Zoroastrianisme, dan Zurvanisme, yang dikaitkan dengan kegelapan serta kekacauan.
claims.quote: Ahriman is the evil spirit in Early Iranian Religion, Zoroastrianism, and Zorvanism, Lord of Darkness and Chaos

claims.statement: Angra Mainyu is another name for Ahriman.
claims.statement_id: Angra Mainyu menjadi nama lain Ahriman.
claims.quote: He is also known as Angra Mainyu (evil spirit or dark spirit)

claims.statement: The source places Ahriman in opposition to Spenta Mainyu and Ahura Mazda.
claims.statement_id: Sumber menjelaskan Ahriman berlawanan dengan Spenta Mainyu dan Ahura Mazda.
claims.quote: exists in opposition to Spenta Mainyu (good spirit or bright spirit) also known as Ahura Mazda and Ormuzd

claims.statement: In Zurvanism, Zurvan gives birth to Ahura Mazda and Ahriman.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Zurvanisme, Zurvan melahirkan Ahura Mazda dan Ahriman.
claims.quote: Zorvan gave birth to both Ahura Mazda and Ahriman

claims.statement: In the quoted account by Hinnells, Ahriman inhabits an abyss of endless northern darkness.
claims.statement_id: Dalam uraian Hinnells yang dikutip, Ahriman mendiami jurang kegelapan tanpa akhir di utara.
claims.quote: dwells in an abyss of endless darkness in the north

claims.statement: Ahriman can change form into a lizard, snake, or young man.
claims.statement_id: Ahriman dapat berubah bentuk menjadi kadal, ular, atau pemuda.
claims.quote: He can change his outward form and appear as a lizard, a snake, or a youth.

claims.statement: Ahriman’s aim is described as destroying Ahura Mazda’s creation.
claims.statement_id: Tujuan Ahriman dijelaskan sebagai menghancurkan ciptaan Ahura Mazda.
claims.quote: His aim is always to destroy the creation of [Ahura Mazda]

claims.statement: Ahriman counters life with death and health with disease.
claims.statement_id: Ahriman membalas kehidupan dengan kematian dan kesehatan dengan penyakit.
claims.quote: As Ahura Mazda creates life, Ahriman creates death; for health, he produces disease; for beauty, ugliness.

claims.statement: The account includes Gavaevodta, the Primordial Bull.
claims.statement_id: Kisah yang dibahas melibatkan Gavaevodta, Banteng Primordial.
claims.quote: Gavaevodta, the Primordial Bull

claims.statement: Gayomartan is also killed by Ahriman in that account.
claims.statement_id: Gayomartan juga dibunuh oleh Ahriman dalam kisah itu.
claims.quote: who is also beautiful and quickly killed by Ahriman.

claims.statement: Ahriman lies to the first human couple by claiming to be their creator.
claims.statement_id: Ahriman membisikkan kebohongan kepada pasangan manusia pertama bahwa dialah pencipta mereka.
claims.quote: Ahriman appears and whispers lies to them, telling them he is their creator

claims.statement: His Avestan name is Angra Mainyu.
claims.statement_id: Nama Avestanya adalah Angra Mainyu.
claims.quote: His Avestan name is Angra Mainyu

claims.statement: In the Gathas, angra mainyu is not yet a proper name.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Gatha, angra mainyu belum diperlakukan sebagai nama diri.
claims.quote: angra mainyu is not yet a proper name.

claims.statement: Angra Mainyu falls into a stupor when Ahura Mazda recites Ahuna Vairya.
claims.statement_id: Pembacaan Ahuna Vairya oleh Ahura Mazda disebut membuat Angra Mainyu terpana.
claims.quote: Ahura Mazda's recital of the Ahuna Vairya invocation puts Angra Mainyu in a stupor.

claims.statement: The introduction to Vendidad I describes sixteen lands created by Ahura Mazda and opposing plagues created by Angra Mainyu.
claims.statement_id: Pengantar terjemahan Vendidad I menjelaskan enam belas negeri ciptaan Ahura Mazda dan wabah tandingannya dari Angra Mainyu.
claims.quote: This chapter is an enumeration of sixteen perfect lands created by Ahura Mazda, and of as many plagues created in opposition by Angra Mainyu.

claims.statement: Iblis is an Islamic religious figure regarded as leader of the devils.
claims.statement_id: Iblis adalah tokoh ajaran Islam yang dianggap pemimpin para setan.
claims.quote: Iblis (bahasa Arab: إبليس, iblīs) merupakan tokoh dalam ajaran Islam yang dipandang sebagai pemimpin para setan.

claims.statement: Quran 18:50 identifies Iblis as one of the jinn who refuses the command to bow.
claims.statement_id: Al-Qur’an 18:50 menyebut Iblis berasal dari jin dan menolak perintah bersujud.
claims.quote: they all bowed but Iblis. He was one of the jinni and rebelled against his Lord's command.

claims.statement: The verse describes Iblis and his offspring as enemies of humanity.
claims.statement_id: Ayat itu menyebut Iblis dan keturunannya sebagai musuh manusia.
claims.quote: And yet you take him and his offspring as your friends instead of Me, even though they are your enemies.

claims.statement: In Quran 7:12, Iblis claims superiority because he is created from fire and Adam from clay.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Al-Qur’an 7:12, Iblis menyatakan dirinya lebih baik karena dibuat dari api, sedangkan Adam dari tanah liat.
claims.quote: "I am better than him," said he. "You created me from fire, and him from clay."

claims.statement: Hamid Algar traces a possible origin of Eblis to Greek diabolos.
claims.statement_id: Hamid Algar mengaitkan kemungkinan asal kata Eblis dengan diabolos Yunani.
claims.quote: The word Eblīs, a Koranic designation for the devil, appears to derive ultimately from the Greek diabolos.

claims.statement: Some interpreters connect the name with Arabic ublisa.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian penafsir menghubungkan nama itu dengan ublisa dalam bahasa Arab.
claims.quote: Some authorities have nonetheless imaginatively connected it with Arabic ublisa

claims.statement: Algar emphasizes that verse 18:50 identifies Eblis as being from the jinn.
claims.statement_id: Algar menegaskan bahwa ayat 18:50 menyebut Eblis berasal dari jin.
claims.quote: 18:50 says clearly of Eblīs, “he was from the jinn”

claims.statement: Many of the Sufi writers discussed regard egoism as the cause of Iblis’s downfall.
claims.statement_id: Banyak penulis Sufi yang dibahas menilai egoisme sebagai sumber kejatuhan Iblis.
claims.quote: Many of them regarded as the main source of his undoing the egoism

claims.statement: Sufi interpretation also identifies envy as a vice of Eblis.
claims.statement_id: Penafsiran Sufi juga menyebut iri sebagai keburukan Iblis.
claims.quote: Envy (ḥasad) is also discerned as one of the fatal vices of Eblīs

claims.statement: In that Sufi account, Eblis misguides people by promoting his own vices.
claims.statement_id: Dalam uraian Sufi tersebut, Iblis menyesatkan manusia dengan menularkan sifat buruknya.
claims.quote: It is in large part by promoting his own vices among men that Eblīs deludes and misguides them

claims.statement: That account describes Eblis persuading people to perform good acts for malicious ends.
claims.statement_id: Uraian itu menyebut Iblis dapat membujuk perbuatan baik untuk tujuan buruk.
claims.quote: Eblīs persuades people to perform good acts for ultimately malicious purposes

claims.statement: For the Sufis discussed, Eblis as tempter has an existence external to humanity.
claims.statement_id: Bagi penulis Sufi yang dibahas, Eblis sebagai penggoda memiliki keberadaan di luar manusia.
claims.quote: for the Sufis Eblīs, as the agent of temptation, has a real existence external to man.

claims.statement: Some Sufi expressions also treat Eblis as sinful inclinations internal to humanity.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian ungkapan Sufi juga memperlakukan Eblis sebagai kecenderungan berdosa di dalam manusia.
claims.quote: Eblīs is indistinguishable from the sinful inclinations of man and is therefore internal to him.

claims.statement: Algar cites al-Ghazali describing Eblis taking the forms of dogs, pigs, and frogs.
claims.statement_id: Algar mengutip al-Ghazali yang menyebut Iblis mengambil bentuk anjing, babi, dan katak.
claims.quote: Ḡazālī observes, however, that Eblīs sometimes assumes the form of animals such as dogs, pigs, and frogs

claims.statement: Algar reports Attar suggesting Eblis may ultimately be rehabilitated.
claims.statement_id: Algar menyebut Attar membuka kemungkinan pemulihan Iblis pada akhirnya.
claims.quote: ʿAṭṭār suggests that he may ultimately be rehabilitated

claims.statement: In the Sahih International translation, Iblees vows to make disobedience attractive to people on earth and to mislead them all.
claims.statement_id: Dalam terjemahan Sahih International, Iblis bersumpah akan menjadikan ketidaktaatan tampak menarik bagi manusia di bumi dan menyesatkan mereka semua.
claims.quote: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all

claims.statement: Iblees asks for a delay until the Day of Resurrection and vows to destroy the descendants of the one honored above him, except a few.
claims.statement_id: Iblis meminta ditangguhkan sampai Hari Kebangkitan dan berjanji akan membinasakan keturunan makhluk yang dimuliakan di atasnya, kecuali sedikit.
claims.quote: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few."

claims.statement: This verse describes Satan told to incite whoever he can with his voice, assault with horses and foot soldiers, and become a partner in their wealth and children; his promise is only delusion.
claims.statement_id: Ayat ini menggambarkan Setan diizinkan menghasut siapa saja yang ia mampu dengan suaranya, menyerang dengan pasukan berkuda dan pejalan kaki, serta menjadi sekutu dalam harta dan anak mereka; janjinya hanyalah tipuan.
claims.quote: And incite [to senselessness] whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them." But Satan does not promise them except delusion.

claims.statement: Allah declares that Iblis has no authority over His servants, except the deviators who follow him.
claims.statement_id: Allah menyatakan Iblis tidak memiliki kuasa atas hamba-hamba-Nya, kecuali orang menyimpang yang mengikutinya.
claims.quote: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

claims.statement: Satan's authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allah.
claims.statement_id: Kuasa Setan hanya atas mereka yang menjadikannya sekutu dan mereka yang karena dia mempersekutukan Allah.
claims.quote: His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allah.

claims.statement: Allah orders Satan out of Paradise, reproached and expelled, and says He will fill Hell with him and whoever follows him.
claims.statement_id: Allah memerintahkan Setan keluar dari Surga, tercela dan terusir, dan berfirman bahwa Dia pasti memenuhi Neraka dengan Setan dan siapa pun yang mengikutinya.
claims.quote: [Allah] said, "Get out of Paradise, reproached and expelled. Whoever follows you among them - I will surely fill Hell with you, all together."

claims.statement: Satan caused them to slip and be removed from their former condition, and they were told to go down as enemies to one another.
claims.statement_id: Setan membuat mereka tergelincir dan dikeluarkan dari keadaan semula, lalu diperintahkan turun sebagai musuh satu sama lain.
claims.quote: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another

claims.statement: Allah has cursed Satan, who said he would take a specific portion of His servants.
claims.statement_id: Allah mengutuk Setan, yang telah berkata akan mengambil bagian tertentu dari hamba-hamba-Nya.
claims.quote: Whom Allah has cursed. For he had said, "I will surely take from among Your servants a specific portion.

claims.statement: Those who recite the Qur'an are told first to seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the one expelled from His mercy.
claims.statement_id: Pembaca Al-Qur'an diperintahkan lebih dulu berlindung kepada Allah dari Setan yang terusir dari rahmat-Nya.
claims.quote: So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].

claims.statement: According to Encyclopaedia Iranica, the most frequently cited hadith speaks of Eblis having a throne on the waters from which he sends forth his hosts.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopaedia Iranica, hadis yang paling sering dikutip menyebut Iblis memiliki singgasana di atas air sebagai pangkal tempat ia mengirim bala tentaranya.
claims.quote: the most frequently cited being that in which the Prophet speaks of Eblīs having a throne “on the Waters,” which serves as the base from which he sends forth his hosts

claims.statement: Encyclopaedia Iranica notes that Quran 26:95 speaks of the hosts of Eblis being cast into Hellfire on the Day of Judgement.
claims.statement_id: Encyclopaedia Iranica mencatat bahwa Al-Qur'an 26:95 menyebut bala tentara Iblis dilemparkan ke Api Neraka pada Hari Penghakiman.
claims.quote: 26:95, speaks of “the hosts of Eblīs” (jonūd Eblīs) being cast into Hellfire on the Day of Judgement.

claims.statement: According to Encyclopaedia Iranica, Eblis is generally understood as the father of the jinn, just as his adversary Adam was the father of mankind, even by authors who regard him as a fallen angel.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopaedia Iranica, Iblis umumnya dipahami sebagai bapak para jin, seperti lawannya Adam adalah bapak umat manusia, bahkan oleh penulis yang menganggapnya malaikat yang jatuh.
claims.quote: Eblīs is generally understood, even by authors who regard him as fallen angel, as the father of the jinn, just as his adversary Adam was the father of mankind

claims.statement: According to Encyclopaedia Iranica, narratives outside the Quran give Eblis named offspring, each entrusted with fostering a different vice among men.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopaedia Iranica, kisah di luar Al-Qur'an menyebut Iblis memiliki anak-anak bernama, masing-masing diberi tugas menumbuhkan satu kejahatan berbeda di antara manusia.
claims.quote: extra-Koranic narratives attribute to him in addition the procreation of a named offspring, specifically and recognizably his own, each child being entrusted with the fostering of a different vice among men.

claims.statement: According to Encyclopaedia Iranica, sins such as lust, gluttony, acquisitiveness and above all anger provide dangerous inroads for Eblis into the human soul.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopaedia Iranica, dosa seperti nafsu, kerakusan, ketamakan, dan terutama amarah menjadi jalan masuk berbahaya bagi Iblis ke dalam jiwa manusia.
claims.quote: sins such as lust, gluttony, acquisitiveness, and, above all, anger provide dangerous inroads for Eblīs into the human soul

claims.statement: According to Encyclopaedia Iranica, the foremost Sufis were regarded as God's purified servants, who lie beyond the reach of Eblis's powers.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopaedia Iranica, para sufi terkemuka dianggap termasuk hamba-hamba Allah yang disucikan, yang berada di luar jangkauan kuasa Iblis.
claims.quote: Numerous anecdotes relate his encounters with Sufis, at least the foremost of whom were regarded as falling within the category of God’s “purified servants” (Qurʾān, 15:40) who lie beyond the reach of his powers

claims.statement: Simurgh is a Persian mythical bird also called Senmurw.
claims.statement_id: Simurgh adalah burung mitos Persia yang juga disebut Senmurw.
claims.quote: SIMORḠ (Persian), Sēnmurw (Pahlavi), Sīna-Mrū (Pāzand), a fabulous, mythical bird.

claims.statement: The name Simurgh is traced to the Avestan expression for the bird Saena.
claims.statement_id: Nama Simurgh ditelusuri ke ungkapan Avesta burung Saena.
claims.quote: The name derives from Avestan ... ‘the bird Saēna’, originally a raptor, either eagle or falcon

claims.statement: The Yasht situates Saēna’s tree in the middle of the sea.
claims.statement_id: Pohon Saena dalam Yasht berada di tengah laut.
claims.quote: Saēna’s tree stands in the middle of the sea

claims.statement: Simorḡ acts as Zāl-e zar’s guardian, savior, and tutor.
claims.statement_id: Simorgh disebut sebagai penyelamat, pendidik, dan penjaga Zal-e Zar.
claims.quote: Simorḡ is the savior, tutor and guardian of Zāl-e zar.

claims.statement: Kamak is identified as Senmurw’s evil bird counterpart.
claims.statement_id: Kamak disebut sebagai burung padanan jahat Senmurw.
claims.quote: The Sēnmurw has an evil counterpart in the bird Kamak

claims.statement: The source distinguishes the protector of Zal and Rostam from an evil bird with the same name.
claims.statement_id: Sumber membedakan Simurgh pelindung Zal dan Rostam dari burung jahat bernama sama.
claims.quote: The Simorḡ, protector of Zāl and Rostam, has an evil counterpart called by the same name.

claims.statement: The accompanying source describes Simurgh giving Zal three feathers to summon her for help.
claims.statement_id: Sumber pendamping menyebut Simurgh memberi Zal tiga bulu untuk memanggilnya saat memerlukan bantuan.
claims.quote: Simurgh gave Zal three of her feathers to call upon her if he should ever need help.

claims.statement: In Renninger's retelling of the Shahnameh, the Simurgh is a giant bird so large that she carries elephants in her claws to her nestlings.
claims.statement_id: Dalam penceritaan ulang Syahnameh oleh Renninger, Simurgh adalah burung raksasa yang begitu besar sampai membawa gajah dalam cakarnya untuk anak-anaknya.
claims.quote: Now the Simurgh is a giant bird, so large that she carrieth elephants in her claws unto her nestlings.

claims.statement: In this retelling, the people also call the Simurgh the Bird of God.
claims.statement_id: Dalam penceritaan ulang ini, rakyat juga menyebut Simurgh Burung Tuhan.
claims.quote: it is not surprising that, by the people, the Simurgh is also called the Bird of God.

claims.statement: The Simurgh gives Zal a golden feather and says that when he is in difficulty or danger he should place it on the fire and she will come instantly to secure his safety.
claims.statement_id: Simurgh memberi Zal sehelai bulu emas dan berkata bahwa bila Zal dalam kesulitan atau bahaya, bulu itu diletakkan di atas api dan ia akan segera datang menjamin keselamatannya.
claims.quote: take and bear with thee into the world this golden feather from her breast, and when thou art involved in difficulty or danger place it upon the fire. I will then come unto thee instantly to secure thy safety.

claims.statement: The Simurgh draws four arrow-heads from the wounded Rustem's body with her beak, then caresses the wounds with her wings, and in a moment all his strength returns.
claims.statement_id: Simurgh menarik empat mata panah dari tubuh Rustem yang terluka dengan paruhnya, lalu membelai luka itu dengan sayapnya, dan seketika kekuatan Rustem pulih.
claims.quote: the glorious Simurgh, swiftly passing her golden beak over the body of the wounded Hero, drew thence four wicked arrow-heads. Then caressing the wounds softly and lightly with her fluffy wings, lo, in a moment, Rustem felt all his strength return.

claims.statement: The Simurgh tells Rustem to choose the finest branch of the tamarisk tree, because the fate of Isfendiyar is bound to that bough.
claims.statement_id: Simurgh menyuruh Rustem memilih dahan tamariska terbaik karena nasib Isfendiyar terikat pada dahan itu.
claims.quote: choose from this tree the longest, straightest and finest branch that thou canst find, for to this tamarisk bough is bound the fate of Isfendiyar.

claims.statement: In Isfendiyar's tale, the swords and javelins on his carriage lacerate the giant bird's claws and beak until she is weakened by blood loss, and Isfendiyar cleaves her in two with his sword.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Isfendiyar, pedang dan lembing pada kereta melukai cakar dan paruh burung raksasa itu hingga ia lemah kehilangan darah, lalu Isfendiyar membelahnya dengan pedang.
claims.quote: But alas! the swords and javelins cruelly lacerated both claws and beak, so that after a time the great bird became extremely weakened by the loss of blood. Then Isfendiyar, seizing this favorable moment, sprang out of the carriage, and with his sword cleft the mighty bird in twain.

claims.statement: Rustem gives an onyx bracelet engraved with a Simurgh and says it will protect from the powers of evil, the badge of Rustem and Zal.
claims.statement_id: Rustem memberi gelang oniks berukir Simurgh dan berkata gelang itu akan melindungi dari kuasa jahat, lambang Rustem dan Zal.
claims.quote: an onyx bracelet, upon which was engraved the image of a Simurgh ... for it will protect him from the powers of evil, being the badge of Rustem and of Zal.

claims.statement: According to Encyclopaedia Iranica, in the Yasht Saena's tree has good and potent medicine, is called all-healing, and the seeds of all plants are deposited on it.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopaedia Iranica, dalam Yasht pohon Saena memiliki obat yang baik dan kuat, disebut penyembuh segala penyakit, dan benih semua tumbuhan disimpan padanya.
claims.quote: it has good and potent medicine, is called all-healing, and the seeds of all plants are deposited on it.

claims.statement: According to Encyclopaedia Iranica, in the Pahlavi text when the bird rises a thousand shoots grow from the tree, and when it alights it breaks a thousand shoots and lets the seeds drop.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopaedia Iranica, dalam teks Pahlavi, ketika burung itu naik seribu tunas tumbuh dari pohon, dan ketika hinggap ia mematahkan seribu tunas dan menjatuhkan benihnya.
claims.quote: When the bird rises, a thousand shoots grow from the tree, and when he (or she) alights, he breaks a thousand shoots and lets the seeds drop from them.

claims.statement: According to Encyclopaedia Iranica, at Rostam's birth the Simorgh suggested anaesthetizing the mother with wine before opening her side, prescribed herbs for the wound, and completed the healing by touching it with her feather.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopaedia Iranica, pada kelahiran Rostam, Simorgh menyarankan ibunya dibius dengan anggur sebelum sisinya dibuka dan menetapkan ramuan penyembuh luka; penyembuhan diselesaikan dengan menyentuhkan bulu burung itu.
claims.quote: The bird suggested they anaesthetize the mother with wine before opening up her side and also prescribed the herbs for healing the wound; the healing was completed by touching the wound with the bird’s feather

claims.statement: According to Encyclopaedia Iranica, the Simorgh extracted the arrows and healed the wounds.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopaedia Iranica, Simorgh mencabut anak-anak panah itu dan menyembuhkan luka-lukanya.
claims.quote: she extracted the arrows and healed the wounds.

claims.statement: According to Encyclopaedia Iranica, the Simorgh, knowing the secrets of fate, warned that whoever killed Esfandiar would be damned in this world and the next.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopaedia Iranica, Simorgh yang mengetahui rahasia takdir memperingatkan bahwa siapa pun yang membunuh Esfandiar akan terkutuk di dunia ini dan akhirat.
claims.quote: Knowing the secrets of fate (rāz-e sepehr) she warned that whoever killed Esfandiār would be damned in this and the next world.

claims.statement: According to Encyclopaedia Iranica, the Simorgh who protects Zal and Rostam has an evil counterpart called by the same name: she lives on a mountain, looks like a mountain or a black cloud, can carry off crocodiles, panthers and elephants, and has two young as big as herself.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopaedia Iranica, Simorgh pelindung Zal dan Rostam punya tandingan jahat dengan nama yang sama: ia tinggal di gunung dan tampak seperti gunung atau awan hitam, mampu membawa pergi buaya, macan tutul, dan gajah, dan punya dua anak sebesar dirinya.
claims.quote: has an evil counterpart called by the same name. She lives on a mountain and looks like a mountain or a black cloud; she can carry off crocodiles, panthers and elephants. She has two young ones as big as herself.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Saena (Senmurv) is the great falcon in the top branches of the Tree of All Seeds; when she flaps her wings the seeds are scattered by the winds, with the help of the bird Chamrosh, to land in the earth.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Saena (Senmurv) adalah elang besar di dahan teratas Pohon Segala Benih; ketika mengepakkan sayap, benih tersebar dibawa angin dengan bantuan burung Chamrosh jatuh ke bumi.
claims.quote: Saena (Senmurv) – the great falcon who sits in the top branches of the Tree of All Seeds. When she flaps her wings, the seeds are scattered and carried away by the winds, with the help of the bird Chamrosh, to land in the earth.

claims.statement: Tiamat is a cosmic ocean paired with Abzu.
claims.statement_id: Tiamat adalah samudra kosmis yang berpasangan dengan Abzu.
claims.quote: Tiamat is the cosmic ocean that mates with Abzû, the groundwater

claims.statement: Tiamat bears the first divine generation after mingling her waters with Abzu.
claims.statement_id: Tiamat melahirkan generasi dewa pertama setelah mencampurkan airnya dengan Abzu.
claims.quote: Tiamat gives birth to the first generation of deities after mingling her waters with those of Abzû.

claims.statement: Tiamat chooses Qingu as a new consort and grants him the Tablet of Destinies.
claims.statement_id: Tiamat memilih Qingu sebagai pasangan baru dan memberinya Lauh Takdir.
claims.quote: She also takes a new consort, Qingu, and bestows on him the Tablet of Destinies

claims.statement: Marduk divides Tiamat’s body to form the elements of the cosmos.
claims.statement_id: Marduk memotong tubuh Tiamat dan membentuk unsur kosmos darinya.
claims.quote: Marduk dismembers her and constructs the elements of the cosmos from the parts.

claims.statement: Alexander Heidel cautions that Tiamat’s dragon form cannot be established with certainty.
claims.statement_id: Alexander Heidel memperingatkan bahwa bentuk naga Tiamat tidak dapat dipastikan.
claims.quote: a "dragon form can not be imputed to Tiamat with certainty."

claims.statement: Marduk defeats and kills Tiamat in battle.
claims.statement_id: Tiamat dikalahkan dan dibunuh Marduk dalam pertempuran.
claims.quote: She was defeated in battle and killed by Marduk.

claims.statement: Nergal is a deity primarily associated with war, death, and disease.
claims.statement_id: Nergal adalah dewa yang terutama dihubungkan dengan perang, kematian, dan penyakit.
claims.quote: He was primarily associated with war, death, and disease

claims.statement: Kutha in northern Babylonia is Nergal’s main cult center.
claims.statement_id: Kutha di Babilonia utara menjadi pusat utama kultus Nergal.
claims.quote: His primary cult center was Kutha, located in the north of historical Babylonia.

claims.statement: Nergal’s main temple is called E-Meslam.
claims.statement_id: Kuil utama Nergal disebut E-Meslam.
claims.quote: His main temple bore the ceremonial name E-Meslam

claims.statement: Nergal is syncretized with Erra at an early date.
claims.statement_id: Nergal disinkretkan dengan Erra sejak masa awal.
claims.quote: The Akkadian god Erra was syncretised with him at an early date

claims.statement: Nergal and Ereshkigal and the Epic of Erra are two myths focused on Nergal.
claims.statement_id: Nergal dan Ereshkigal serta Epos Erra merupakan dua mitos yang berpusat pada Nergal.
claims.quote: Nergal and Ereshkigal and Epic of Erra

claims.statement: Nergal is described as co-ruler with Ereshkigal and originally associated with Shamash.
claims.statement_id: Nergal digambarkan sebagai penguasa bersama Ereshkigal dan mula-mula dihubungkan dengan Shamash.
claims.quote: co-ruler with Ereshkigal, but originally associated with Shamash

claims.statement: Shamash is a Mesopotamian sun deity.
claims.statement_id: Shamash adalah dewa matahari Mesopotamia.
claims.quote: adalah dewa matahari dalam kepercayaan Mesopotamia kuno.

claims.statement: Sippar and Larsa are prominent centers of Shamash’s worship.
claims.statement_id: Sippar dan Larsa menjadi pusat pemujaan Shamash yang menonjol.
claims.quote: pemujaannya paling menonjol di Sippar dan Larsa.

claims.statement: Nanna and Ningal are identified as Shamash’s parents.
claims.statement_id: Nanna dan Ningal disebut sebagai orang tua Shamash.
claims.quote: Dewa bulan Nanna (atau Sin) dan istrinya Ningal dianggap sebagai orang tuanya

claims.statement: Aya, also named Sherida, is Shamash’s wife.
claims.statement_id: Aya atau Sherida disebut sebagai istri Shamash.
claims.quote: Dewi fajar Aya (atau Sherida) adalah istrinya

claims.statement: Shamash governs justice and protects travelers, merchants, soldiers, and sailors.
claims.statement_id: Shamash dipercaya menguasai keadilan dan melindungi musafir, pedagang, tentara, serta pelaut.
claims.quote: Shamash was god of supreme justice and was often invoked for the protection of travelers, merchants, soldiers and sailors.

claims.statement: Shamash is depicted cutting a path through mountains with a blade at dawn.
claims.statement_id: Shamash digambarkan memakai bilah untuk membelah jalan melalui gunung saat fajar.
claims.quote: He is often depicted holding a blade with which he cuts his way through the mountains each morning at dawn.

claims.statement: Tammuz, or Dumuzid, is a Mesopotamian and Levantine deity associated with farming and shepherds.
claims.statement_id: Tammuz atau Dumuzid adalah dewa Mesopotamia dan Syam yang dihubungkan dengan pertanian serta gembala.
claims.quote: adalah dewa Mesopotamia kuno dan Syam yang dikaitkan dengan pertanian dan gembala

claims.statement: Geshtinanna is identified as Dumuzid’s sister.
claims.statement_id: Geshtinanna disebut sebagai saudari Dumuzid.
claims.quote: saudara perempuan Dumuzid adalah Geshtinanna

claims.statement: In one poem, Dumuzid competes with Enkimdu to marry Inanna.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu puisi, Dumuzid bersaing dengan Enkimdu untuk menikahi Inanna.
claims.quote: Dumuzid bersaing dengan petani Enkimdu untuk mempersunting Inanna.

claims.statement: Tammuz is named directly in the Book of Ezekiel.
claims.statement_id: Tammuz disebut secara langsung dalam Kitab Yehezkiel.
claims.quote: Tammuz disebutkan namanya secara langsung dalam Kitab Yehezkiel

claims.statement: Dumuzi replaces Inanna in the underworld in the summarized account.
claims.statement_id: Dumuzi menggantikan Inanna di dunia bawah dalam kisah yang diringkas.
claims.quote: He takes Inanna's place in the underworld after she is trapped and killed there by Ereshkigal

claims.statement: Dumuzi and Geshtinanna alternate half-year stays in the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Dumuzi dan Geshtinanna bergantian tinggal di dunia bawah selama setengah tahun.
claims.quote: He remains in the underworld for half the year and Geshtinanna the other half

claims.statement: Abzu, or Apsu, is a freshwater deity in Babylonian, Akkadian, and Sumerian traditions.
claims.statement_id: Abzu atau Apsu adalah dewa air tawar dalam tradisi Babilonia, Akkadia, dan Sumeria.
claims.quote: ABSU - The Babylonian, Akkadian and Sumerian god of fresh water and the sweet waters of the world.

claims.statement: Apsu, or Abzu, is described as encircling the earth.
claims.statement_id: Apsu atau Abzu dikisahkan mengelilingi bumi.
claims.quote: Also known as Apsu and Abzu, he encircled the earth

claims.statement: Abzu mingles his fresh waters with Tiamat’s salt waters.
claims.statement_id: Abzu mencampurkan air tawarnya dengan air asin pasangan Tiamat.
claims.quote: merged his fresh waters with the salt waters of his consort, Tiamat

claims.statement: In that account, the other gods are born from Abzu and Tiamat’s union.
claims.statement_id: Dalam uraian itu, dewa-dewa lain lahir dari persatuan Abzu dan Tiamat.
claims.quote: from their union all the other gods were born.

claims.statement: Ea kills Abzu, provoking the gods’ war with Tiamat.
claims.statement_id: Ea membunuh Abzu sehingga memicu perang para dewa dengan Tiamat.
claims.quote: He was killed by his son, Ea, which provoked the war of the gods with Tiamat.

claims.statement: Alongside its cosmological usage, Abzu appears as a deity in the Enuma Elish.
claims.statement_id: Selain sebutan kosmologis, Abzu tampil sebagai dewa dalam Enuma Elish.
claims.quote: Abzû (apsû) is depicted as a deity only in the Babylonian creation epic, the Enūma Eliš

claims.statement: Al-Lat is a goddess of pre-Islamic Arabia.
claims.statement_id: Al-Lat adalah dewi Arab pra-Islam.
claims.quote: is a pre-Islamic Arabian goddess

claims.statement: Al-Lat is worshipped alongside Al-Uzza and Manat.
claims.statement_id: Al-Lat dipuja bersama Al-Uzza dan Manat.
claims.quote: she was worshipped alongside Al-Uzza and Manat.

claims.statement: Al-Lat’s cult reaches Syria.
claims.statement_id: Kultus Al-Lat meluas hingga Suriah.
claims.quote: her cult reached as far as Syria.

claims.statement: Safaitic inscriptions frequently invoke Al-Lat.
claims.statement_id: Prasasti beraksara Safaitic kerap menyerukan Al-Lat.
claims.quote: The writers of the Safaitic script frequently invoked al-Lat in their inscriptions.

claims.statement: The Nabataeans worship Al-Lat and associate her with Al-Uzza.
claims.statement_id: Bangsa Nabatea memuja Al-Lat dan menghubungkannya dengan Al-Uzza.
claims.quote: She was also worshipped by the Nabataeans and was associated with al-'Uzza.

claims.statement: Quran 53:19 names al-Lat alongside al-Uzza.
claims.statement_id: Al-Qur’an 53:19 menyebut Al-Lat bersama Al-Uzza.
claims.quote: Have you considered Lat and ‘Uzza?
claims.detail: tidak bisa dibuka (fetch failed); dicek lewat arsip Wayback

claims.statement: A ghoul is a demon-like or monstrous humanoid being in folklore.
claims.statement_id: Ghoul adalah makhluk mirip iblis atau manusia monster dalam cerita rakyat.
claims.quote: a ghoul (from Arabic: غول, ghūl) is a demon-like being or monstrous humanoid

claims.statement: The ghoul concept originates in pre-Islamic Arabian religion.
claims.statement_id: Konsep ghoul berasal dari agama Arab pra-Islam.
claims.quote: The concept of the ghoul originated in pre-Islamic Arabian religion.

claims.statement: Al-Dimashqi describes ghouls as cave dwellers that emerge at night and avoid sunlight.
claims.statement_id: Al-Dimashqi menggambarkan ghoul sebagai penghuni gua yang keluar malam dan menghindari matahari.
claims.quote: Al-Dimashqi describes the ghoul as cave-dwelling animals who only leave at night and avoid the light of the sun.

claims.statement: In the translated Arabian Nights tale, ghouls make their lairs in deserted buildings.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Arabian Nights yang diterjemahkan, ghoul bersarang di bangunan kosong.
claims.quote: making their lairs in deserted buildings

claims.statement: The tale’s ghouls attack unwary travelers and eat their flesh.
claims.statement_id: Ghoul dalam kisah itu menerkam musafir lengah dan memakan daging mereka.
claims.quote: springing out upon unwary travellers whose flesh they eat.

claims.statement: When no live victims appear, the ghouls go to cemeteries and feed on dead bodies.
claims.statement_id: Ketika tidak menemukan manusia hidup, ghoul mendatangi kuburan dan memakan mayat.
claims.quote: If no live being goes their way, they then betake themselves to the cemeteries, and feed upon the dead bodies.

claims.statement: In Lane's notes, Ghools are said to appear as various animals, human beings and monstrous shapes, haunt burial grounds and sequestered spots, feed on dead human bodies, and kill and devour any human who falls in their way.
claims.statement_id: Dalam catatan Lane, Ghool dikatakan tampil dalam wujud berbagai hewan, manusia, dan bentuk mengerikan, menghantui pekuburan dan tempat terpencil, memakan jenazah manusia, serta membunuh dan melahap manusia yang jatuh ke jalannya.
claims.quote: The Ghools are said to appear in the forms of various animals, and of human beings, and in many monstrous shapes; to haunt burial-grounds and other sequestered spots; to feed upon dead human bodies; and to kill and devour any human creature who has the misfortune to fall in their way

claims.statement: In Lane's notes, one opinion says the Ghool appears to a person travelling alone at night in solitary places, is taken for a fellow traveller, and lures him out of his way.
claims.statement_id: Dalam catatan Lane, satu pendapat menyebut Ghool menampakkan diri kepada orang yang bepergian sendirian pada malam hari di tempat sepi, disangka sesama musafir, lalu menyesatkannya dari jalan.
claims.quote: it appears to a person travelling alone in the night and in solitary places, and, being supposed by him to be itself a traveller, lures him out of his way.

claims.statement: In Lane's notes, a tradition says the Ghool is any Jinnee opposed to travels, assuming various forms and appearances.
claims.statement_id: Dalam catatan Lane, sebuah tradisi menyebut Ghool adalah jin mana pun yang menentang perjalanan dan mengambil berbagai bentuk dan rupa.
claims.quote: The Ghool is any Jinnee that is opposed to travels, assuming various forms and appearances;

claims.statement: In Lane's notes, these beings are said to be the offspring of Iblees and a wife God created for him from the fire of the Samoom.
claims.statement_id: Dalam catatan Lane, makhluk-makhluk ini dikatakan keturunan Iblis dan seorang istri yang diciptakan Allah baginya dari api Samoom.
claims.quote: are the offspring of Iblees and of a wife whom God created for him of the fire of the Samoom

claims.statement: In the story of the Prince and the Ghooleh, the woman posing as a princess tells her children she has brought a fat young man, and they want to fill their stomachs with his flesh.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Pangeran dan Ghooleh, perempuan yang menyamar sebagai putri berkata kepada anak-anaknya bahwa ia membawa pemuda gemuk, dan mereka ingin mengisi perut dengan dagingnya.
claims.quote: My children, I have brought you to-day a fat young man:—on which they exclaimed, Bring him in to us, O mother! that we may fill our stomachs with his flesh.

claims.statement: In the same story, the Ghooleh departs from the Prince as soon as she hears his prayer to God.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah yang sama, Ghooleh pergi dari sang pangeran begitu mendengar doanya kepada Allah.
claims.quote: the Ghooleh no sooner heard his prayer, than she departed from him.

claims.statement: According to this article, in tales told to girls and young women the ghoul appears to men as a long-lost female relative or an unassuming old woman and lures them into her home to eat them.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, dalam kisah yang diceritakan kepada gadis dan perempuan muda, ghoul menampakkan diri kepada lelaki sebagai kerabat perempuan yang lama hilang atau perempuan tua biasa, memikat mereka ke rumahnya untuk dimakan.
claims.quote: In these tales, the ghoul appears to men as a long-lost female relative or an unassuming old woman; she uses this glamor to lure the hapless characters, who are usually husbands or fathers, into her home, where she can eat them.

claims.statement: According to this article, the ghoul is said to lure unwary people into the desert or abandoned places to slay and devour them; it also preys on young children, drinks blood, steals coins, eats the dead, and takes the form of the person most recently eaten.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, ghoul dikatakan memikat orang lengah ke gurun atau tempat terbengkalai untuk dibunuh dan dimakan; ia juga memangsa anak kecil, meminum darah, mencuri koin, memakan orang mati, dan mengambil rupa orang yang paling baru dimakan.
claims.quote: The ghoul is said to lure unwary people into the desert wastes or abandoned places to slay and devour them. The creature also preys on young children, drinks blood, steals coins, eats the dead, and takes the form of the person most recently eaten.

claims.statement: According to this article, a hadith mentioned by Al-Damiri says lonely travelers can escape a ghoul's attack by reciting the adhan.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, sebuah hadis yang disebut Al-Damiri mengatakan musafir yang sendirian dapat lolos dari serangan ghoul dengan mengumandangkan adzan.
claims.quote: In one hadith mentioned by Al-Damīrī, is said, lonely travelers can escape a ghoul's attack by reciting the adhan (call to prayer).

claims.statement: According to this article, Al-Masudi reports that on his journey to Syria Umar slew a ghoul with his sword.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, Al-Masudi melaporkan bahwa dalam perjalanannya ke Syria, Umar membunuh seekor ghoul dengan pedangnya.
claims.quote: Al-Masudi reports that on his journey to Syria, Umar slew a ghoul with his sword.
