claims.statement: Moloch is traditionally interpreted as the name of a Canaanite deity.
claims.statement_id: Moloch secara tradisional ditafsirkan sebagai nama dewa Kanaan.
claims.quote: Traditionally, the name Moloch has been understood as referring to a Canaanite god.

claims.statement: Scholars also propose that Moloch denotes a sacrifice rather than a deity.
claims.statement_id: Peneliti juga mengusulkan Moloch sebagai sebutan pengorbanan, bukan nama dewa.
claims.quote: scholars have speculated that Moloch refers to the sacrifice itself

claims.statement: The sacrifice interpretation becomes more popular but remains disputed.
claims.statement_id: Penafsiran sebagai pengorbanan semakin populer tetapi tetap diperdebatkan.
claims.quote: This second position has grown increasingly popular, but it remains contested.

claims.statement: Medieval depictions often give Moloch a bull-headed idol form with hands extended over fire.
claims.statement_id: Sejak abad pertengahan, Moloch kerap digambarkan sebagai patung berkepala banteng dengan tangan terulur di atas api.
claims.quote: Since the medieval period, Moloch has often been portrayed as a bull-headed idol with outstretched hands over a fire

claims.statement: The Bible condemns practices associated with Moloch.
claims.statement_id: Alkitab mengecam praktik yang dihubungkan dengan Moloch.
claims.quote: The Bible strongly condemns practices that are associated with Moloch

claims.statement: The spelling Moloch follows the Greek Septuagint and Latin Vulgate.
claims.statement_id: Ejaan Moloch mengikuti Septuaginta Yunani dan Vulgata Latin.
claims.quote: The spelling "Moloch" follows the Greek Septuagint and the Latin Vulgate

claims.statement: Leviticus 18:21 in the KJV forbids offering one’s offspring through fire to Molech.
claims.statement_id: Imamat 18:21 dalam terjemahan KJV melarang mempersembahkan keturunan melalui api kepada Molech.
claims.quote: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech

claims.statement: El is the supreme deity of ancient Canaanite religion.
claims.statement_id: El adalah dewa tertinggi agama Kanaan kuno.
claims.quote: was the supreme god of the ancient Canaanite religion.

claims.statement: El is described as father of the gods and creator of humanity.
claims.statement_id: El digambarkan sebagai ayah para dewa dan pencipta manusia.
claims.quote: El is often described as the father of the gods and the creator of humanity.

claims.statement: El presides over a divine council.
claims.statement_id: El memimpin dewan para dewa.
claims.quote: El presided over a council of gods

claims.statement: El’s epithets include Bull El, El the King, and Father of Mankind.
claims.statement_id: Gelar El mencakup Banteng El, El Sang Raja, dan Ayah Manusia.
claims.quote: El had many epithets, including "Bull El," "El the King," and "Father of Mankind,"

claims.statement: In Northwest Semitic usage, el also serves as a general word for a god.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Semit barat laut, el juga merupakan kata umum untuk dewa.
claims.quote: In Northwest Semitic use, ʼel was a generic word for any god

claims.statement: Athirat is named as El’s wife and the mother of the gods.
claims.statement_id: Athirat disebut sebagai istri El dan ibu para dewa.
claims.quote: Athirat, the wife of El and a mother goddess as the mother of the gods.

claims.statement: Dagon, or Dagan, is worshipped in ancient Syria and the middle Euphrates region.
claims.statement_id: Dagon atau Dagan adalah dewa yang dipuja di Suriah kuno dan kawasan Eufrat tengah.
claims.quote: was a god worshipped in ancient Syria, across the middle of the Euphrates

claims.statement: His primary temples stand at Tuttul and Terqa.
claims.statement_id: Kuil utamanya berada di Tuttul dan Terqa.
claims.quote: primary temples located in Tuttul and Terqa

claims.statement: Shalash is named as Dagan’s wife and attested at Tuttul.
claims.statement_id: Shalash disebut sebagai istri Dagan dan tercatat di Tuttul.
claims.quote: His wife was Shalash; while well attested in Tuttul

claims.statement: Hadad and possibly Hebat are identified as Dagan and Shalash’s children.
claims.statement_id: Hadad dan kemungkinan Hebat disebut sebagai anak Dagan dan Shalash.
claims.quote: Their children were Hadad (analogous to Ugaritic Baal) and possibly Hebat

claims.statement: The source cautions against interpreting Dagan as a fish-shaped water deity.
claims.statement_id: Sumber memperingatkan bahwa penafsiran Dagan sebagai dewa air berbentuk ikan adalah keliru.
claims.quote: incorrect interpretation of Dagan as a water deity with fish-like features.

claims.statement: The accompanying source associates Dagon, or Dagan, with grain and fertility.
claims.statement_id: Sumber pendamping mengaitkan Dagon atau Dagan dengan gandum dan kesuburan.
claims.quote: DAGON - Also known as Dagan, he was the Babylonian god of grain and fertility

claims.statement: Hubal is a pre-Islamic Arabian god particularly worshipped by the Quraysh in Mecca.
claims.statement_id: Hubal adalah dewa Arab pra-Islam yang terutama dipuja Quraisy di Mekah.
claims.quote: Hubal (bahasa Arab: هُبَل) adalah salah satu dewa yang dipuja masyarakat Arab Pra-Islam, terutama Bani Quraisy di Mekah.

claims.statement: Hubal is worshipped through a human-shaped statue in the Kaaba.
claims.statement_id: Hubal dipuja melalui arca menyerupai manusia di Ka’bah.
claims.quote: Hubal dipuja dalam bentuk arca menyerupai manusia yang disemayamkan di dalam Ka'bah

claims.statement: Divination uses arrows placed before Hubal’s statue.
claims.statement_id: Ramalan dilakukan menggunakan anak panah di depan arca Hubal.
claims.quote: meramal yang dilakukan dengan melemparkan anak-anak panah di hadapan arcanya.

claims.statement: The Quraysh control access to Hubal’s statue.
claims.statement_id: Quraisy mengendalikan akses menuju arca Hubal.
claims.quote: Akses menuju arca Hubal dikendalikan Bani Quraisy.

claims.statement: Ibn al-Kalbi describes Hubal’s statue as a human figure made of red agate.
claims.statement_id: Ibn al-Kalbi menggambarkan arca Hubal sebagai sosok manusia dari akik merah.
claims.quote: arca Hubal dikatakan menyerupai manusia dan terbuat dari batu akik merah

claims.statement: In that account, the statue’s broken right hand is replaced with gold.
claims.statement_id: Dalam uraian itu, tangan kanan arca yang patah diganti dengan emas.
claims.quote: tangan kanannya sudah patah dan diganti dengan tangan dari emas.

claims.statement: The 1911 Britannica notes that Hobal was set up within the Temple over the pit containing the sacred treasures, and that his chief function was connected with the sacred lot to which the Meccans resorted in all matters of difficulty.
claims.statement_id: Britannica 1911 mencatat Hobal ditempatkan di dalam Bait di atas lubang yang berisi harta suci, dan fungsi utamanya terkait undian suci yang ditempuh orang Mekah dalam segala urusan sulit.
claims.quote: Hobal was set up within the Temple over the pit that contained the sacred treasures. His chief function was connected with the sacred lot to which the Meccans were accustomed to betake themselves in all matters of difficulty.

claims.statement: In the account the 1911 Britannica describes, the Kaaba was perverted to idol worship from the time when ʽAmr ibn Lohai introduced the statue of Hobal from Syria.
claims.statement_id: Dalam uraian yang dimuat Britannica 1911, Ka'bah dikatakan terseret ke penyembahan berhala sejak ʽAmr ibn Lohai membawa patung Hobal dari Suriah.
claims.quote: perverted to idol worship from the time when ʽAmr ibn Lohai introduced the statue of Hobal from Syria

claims.statement: Hisham Ibn Al-Kalbi's Book of Idols describes the image as human-shaped, with the broken right hand replaced by a golden one.
claims.statement_id: Kitab al-Asnam karya Hisham Ibn Al-Kalbi menggambarkan arca itu berbentuk manusia, dengan tangan kanan yang patah diganti tangan emas.
claims.quote: Hisham Ibn Al-Kalbi's Book of Idols describes the image as shaped like a human, with the right hand broken off and replaced with a golden hand.

claims.statement: Hubal's icon was a human figure believed to control divination, performed by tossing arrows before the statue.
claims.statement_id: Arca Hubal berupa sosok manusia yang diyakini mengendalikan ramalan, yang dilakukan dengan melemparkan anak panah di hadapan arca.
claims.quote: The god's icon was a human figure believed to control acts of divination, which was performed by tossing arrows before the statue.

claims.statement: The name Hubal may ultimately derive from the name Baal of the Canaanite pantheon; in particular from Aramaic hu bel, 'he is Baal'.
claims.statement_id: Nama Hubal mungkin pada akhirnya berasal dari nama Baal dalam jajaran dewa Kanaan; secara khusus bisa dari bahasa Aram hu bel, "dia adalah Baal".
claims.quote: The name Hubal may be ultimately derivative of the name Baal from the Canaanite pantheon. In particular, the name could derive from the Aramaic hu bel, meaning "he is Baal".

claims.statement: According to Ibn Al-Kalbi the image was first set up by Khuzayma ibn Mudrika, but another tradition recorded by Ibn Ishaq says Amr ibn Luhayy, a leader of the Khuza'a tribe, put an image of Hubal in the Kaaba.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Ibn Al-Kalbi, arca itu pertama didirikan oleh Khuzayma ibn Mudrika, tetapi tradisi lain yang dicatat Ibn Ishaq menyebut Amr ibn Luhayy, pemimpin suku Khuza'a, menempatkan arca Hubal di Ka'bah.
claims.quote: According to Ibn Al-Kalbi, the image was first set up by Khuzayma ibn Mudrika, but another tradition, recorded by Ibn Ishaq, holds that Amr ibn Luhayy, a leader of the Khuza'a tribe, put an image of Hubal into the Kaaba

claims.statement: A tale recorded by Ibn Al-Kalbi has Muhammad's grandfather Abdul Mutallib vow to sacrifice one of his ten children and consult the arrows of Hubal to choose which.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah kisah yang dicatat Ibn Al-Kalbi menuturkan kakek Muhammad, Abdul Mutallib, bersumpah mengorbankan salah satu dari sepuluh anaknya dan menanyakan anak panah Hubal untuk memilihnya.
claims.quote: A tale recorded by Ibn Al-Kalbi has Muhammad's grandfather Abdul Mutallib vowing to sacrifice one of his ten children. He consulted the arrows of Hubal to find out which child he should choose.

claims.statement: When Muhammad conquered Mecca in 630 he broke the statue of Hubal, with the other 360 images at the Kaaba, and dedicated the structure to Allah.
claims.statement_id: Ketika Muhammad menaklukkan Mekah pada 630, ia menghancurkan arca Hubal beserta 360 arca lain di Ka'bah dan mengabdikan bangunan itu kepada Allah.
claims.quote: When Muhammad conquered Mecca in 630, he broke the statue of Hubal, along with the other 360 images at the Kaaba, and dedicated the structure to Allah.

claims.statement: Mircea Eliade and Charles J. Adams assert he was a god of rain and a warrior god who emerged toward the end of the pre-Islamic era as an intertribal warrior god worshipped by the Quraysh and the allied tribes of the Kinana and Tihama.
claims.statement_id: Mircea Eliade dan Charles J. Adams menyatakan Hubal adalah dewa hujan dan dewa perang yang menjelang akhir masa pra-Islam menjadi dewa perang antarsuku yang dipuja Quraisy serta suku-suku sekutu Kinana dan Tihama.
claims.quote: Mircea Eliade and Charles J. Adams assert that he was "a god of rain and a warrior god. Towards the end of the pre-Islamic era he emerged as an intertribal warrior god worshipped by the Quraysh and the allied tribes of the Kinana and Tihama."

claims.statement: In the early twentieth century Hugo Winckler speculated that Hubal was a lunar deity, a view repeated by other scholars.
claims.statement_id: Hugo Winckler pada awal abad kedua puluh menduga Hubal adalah dewa bulan, pandangan yang diulang oleh sarjana lain.
claims.quote: Hugo Winckler in the early twentieth century speculated that Hubal was a lunar deity, a view that was repeated by other scholars.

claims.statement: More recent scholars have rejected the lunar-deity view, partly because it is speculation.
claims.statement_id: Sarjana yang lebih baru menolak pandangan dewa bulan itu, antara lain karena sifatnya spekulatif.
claims.quote: More recent scholars have rejected this view, partly because it is speculation

claims.statement: The paucity of evidence about Hubal makes it difficult to characterise his role or identity in pagan Arabian mythologies.
claims.statement_id: Sedikitnya bukti tentang Hubal menyulitkan penggambaran peran atau identitasnya dalam mitologi Arab pagan.
claims.quote: The paucity of evidence concerning Hubal makes it difficult to characterise his role or identity in pagan Arabian mythologies.

claims.statement: Nabu is a Babylonian patron of literacy, scribes, wisdom, and rational arts.
claims.statement_id: Nabu adalah dewa Babilonia pelindung baca tulis, juru tulis, kebijaksanaan, dan seni rasional.
claims.quote: is the Babylonian patron god of literacy, scribes, wisdom, and the rational arts.

claims.statement: Babylonian astronomy associates Nabu with Mercury.
claims.statement_id: Nabu dihubungkan dengan Merkurius dalam astronomi Babilonia.
claims.quote: He is associated with the classical planet Mercury in Babylonian astronomy.

claims.statement: Nabu is identified as Marduk’s son.
claims.statement_id: Nabu disebut sebagai putra Marduk.
claims.quote: he was identified as the son of the god Marduk.

claims.statement: Nabu is worshipped at Borsippa.
claims.statement_id: Nabu dipuja di Borsippa.
claims.quote: Nabu was worshipped in Babylon's sister city Borsippa

claims.statement: Tashmet is named as Nabu’s wife.
claims.statement_id: Tashmet disebut sebagai istri Nabu.
claims.quote: His wife was the Akkadian goddess Tashmet.

claims.statement: Nabu is depicted holding a stylus while riding or standing beside a Mushhushshu dragon.
claims.statement_id: Nabu digambarkan memegang pena tulis sambil menaiki atau berdiri di samping naga Mushhushshu.
claims.quote: He is depicted holding a stylus and either riding on or standing beside a Mushhushshu dragon.

claims.statement: Nephilim are enigmatic figures in the Hebrew Bible and later Jewish and Christian literature.
claims.statement_id: Nephilim adalah tokoh misterius dalam Alkitab Ibrani dan sastra Yahudi serta Kristen berikutnya.
claims.quote: are enigmatic figures mentioned in several passages of the Hebrew Bible and later Jewish and Christian literature.

claims.statement: Nephilim are traditionally associated with extraordinary size, strength, or status.
claims.statement_id: Nephilim secara tradisional dikaitkan dengan ukuran, kekuatan, atau kedudukan luar biasa.
claims.quote: They are traditionally associated with extraordinary size, strength, or status

claims.statement: The earliest reference discussed occurs in Genesis 6:1–4.
claims.statement_id: Rujukan pertama yang dibahas terdapat pada Kejadian 6:1–4.
claims.quote: The earliest reference appears in Genesis 6:1–4

claims.statement: The meaning of Nephilim remains uncertain.
claims.statement_id: Arti istilah Nephilim tidak pasti.
claims.quote: The meaning of the term Nephilim is uncertain.

claims.statement: Nephilim appear again in Numbers 13:33.
claims.statement_id: Nephilim disebut lagi dalam Bilangan 13:33.
claims.quote: The Nephilim appear again in Numbers 13:33

claims.statement: One interpretation identifies Nephilim as offspring of rebellious angels and human women.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu penafsiran menjadikan Nephilim keturunan malaikat pemberontak dan perempuan manusia.
claims.quote: identifies the Nephilim as the offspring of rebellious angels (the Watchers) and human women

claims.statement: Genesis 6:4 in the KJV describes giants on the earth in those days.
claims.statement_id: Kejadian 6:4 dalam terjemahan KJV menyebut raksasa berada di bumi pada masa itu.
claims.quote: There were giants in the earth in those days;

claims.statement: In the KJV of Genesis 6:4, they became mighty men of old, men of renown.
claims.statement_id: Dalam terjemahan KJV Kejadian 6:4, mereka menjadi orang-orang perkasa yang termasyhur pada zaman dahulu.
claims.quote: the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

claims.statement: In the KJV of Numbers 13:33, the spies report that they saw the giants, the sons of Anak, and were as grasshoppers in their own sight and in the giants' sight.
claims.statement_id: Dalam KJV Bilangan 13:33, para pengintai melaporkan bahwa di sana mereka melihat raksasa, anak-anak Anak; mereka merasa seperti belalang di mata sendiri dan di mata raksasa itu.
claims.quote: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

claims.statement: According to this article, an influential view in Second Temple literature portrays the Nephilim as destructive giants whose corruption contributed to the moral decline preceding the flood.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, pandangan berpengaruh dalam sastra Bait Kedua menggambarkan Nephilim sebagai raksasa perusak yang kebejatannya menyumbang pada kemerosotan moral sebelum air bah.
claims.quote: portraying them as destructive giants whose corruption contributed to the moral decline preceding the flood.

claims.statement: According to this article, the Book of Jubilees also states that ridding the Earth of the Nephilim was one of God's purposes for the flood in Noah's time.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, Kitab Yobel juga menyatakan bahwa membersihkan bumi dari Nephilim adalah salah satu tujuan Allah mendatangkan air bah pada zaman Nuh.
claims.quote: the Book of Jubilees (7:21–25) also states that ridding the Earth of these Nephilim was one of God's purposes for flooding the Earth in Noah's time.

claims.statement: In the same chapter the KJV records that the earth was corrupt before God and filled with violence.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bab yang sama, KJV mencatat bahwa bumi rusak di hadapan Allah dan penuh kekerasan.
claims.quote: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

claims.statement: In the Book of Enoch (Charles translation), the women become pregnant and bear great giants whose height was three thousand ells.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Kitab Henokh (terjemahan Charles), para perempuan mengandung dan melahirkan raksasa besar setinggi tiga ribu hasta.
claims.quote: And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells

claims.statement: The giants consumed all the acquisitions of men.
claims.statement_id: Raksasa-raksasa itu menghabiskan semua harta milik manusia.
claims.quote: Who consumed all the acquisitions of men.

claims.statement: When men could no longer sustain them, the giants turned against them and devoured mankind.
claims.statement_id: Ketika manusia tak lagi mampu menopang mereka, para raksasa berbalik melawan manusia dan melahap umat manusia.
claims.quote: And when men could no longer sustain them, the giants turned against them and devoured mankind.

claims.statement: They began to sin against birds, beasts, reptiles and fish, and to devour one another's flesh and drink the blood.
claims.statement_id: Mereka mulai berdosa terhadap burung, binatang, reptil, dan ikan, serta saling melahap daging dan meminum darah.
claims.quote: And they began to sin against birds, and beasts, and reptiles, and fish, and to devour one another's flesh, and drink the blood.

claims.statement: In the command to Gabriel, the children of the Watchers are to be sent against one another to destroy each other in battle, and they shall not have length of days.
claims.statement_id: Dalam perintah kepada Gabriel, anak-anak para Pengawas disuruh dibinasakan dengan diadu satu sama lain dalam pertempuran, dan mereka tidak akan panjang umur.
claims.quote: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.

claims.statement: The spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction and trouble on the earth.
claims.statement_id: Roh-roh para raksasa menyiksa, menindas, membinasakan, menyerang, berperang, dan mendatangkan kehancuran serta kesusahan di bumi.
claims.quote: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble

claims.statement: The giants, produced from spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth and dwell on the earth.
claims.statement_id: Para raksasa yang lahir dari roh dan daging akan disebut roh jahat di bumi dan tinggal di bumi.
claims.quote: And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.

claims.statement: Anahita is an Iranian goddess.
claims.statement_id: Anahita adalah dewi Iran.
claims.quote: Anahita /ɑːnəˈhiːtə/ is an Iranian goddess.

claims.statement: Anahita is praised in the Aban Yasht of the Avesta.
claims.statement_id: Anahita dipuji dalam Aban Yasht yang terdapat di Avesta.
claims.quote: She is praised in the Aban Yasht, one of the Zoroastrian hymns contained in the Avesta

claims.statement: Middle Persian renders her name Ardwisur Anahid.
claims.statement_id: Bahasa Persia Tengah menyebutnya Ardwisur Anahid.
claims.quote: In Middle Persian, her name was rendered Ardwisur Anahid.

claims.statement: Anahita is associated with fertility, procreation, and wisdom.
claims.statement_id: Anahita dihubungkan dengan kesuburan, kelahiran, dan kebijaksanaan.
claims.quote: Anahita is associated with fertility, procreation, and wisdom.

claims.statement: Anahita’s temples are built beside streams and watercourses.
claims.statement_id: Kuil Anahita dibangun di dekat aliran air.
claims.quote: Temples to Anahita were built next to streams and other watercourses.

claims.statement: Anahita is associated with Mithra, with the dove and peacock identified as her sacred animals.
claims.statement_id: Anahita dihubungkan dengan Mithra; merpati dan merak menjadi hewan sucinya.
claims.quote: She was closely associated with the god Mithra and her sacred animals were the dove and peacock.

claims.statement: Ashur, or Assur, is the supreme Assyrian deity.
claims.statement_id: Ashur atau Assur adalah dewa tertinggi Asyur.
claims.quote: ASSUR - Also known as Ashur and, in Akkadian, Anshar. The supreme god of the Assyrians

claims.statement: Ashur originates as the local deity of the city bearing his name.
claims.statement_id: Ashur berasal sebagai dewa lokal kota Ashur.
claims.quote: originated as a local deity of the city of Ashur.

claims.statement: Ashur governs the sky and war, with the title Lord of the Whole Heavens.
claims.statement_id: Ashur adalah dewa langit dan perang bergelar Penguasa Seluruh Langit.
claims.quote: He was the Assyrian god of the sky and of war known as The Lord of the Whole Heavens.

claims.statement: Assyrian kings invoke Ashur as a powerful ally.
claims.statement_id: Raja Asyur menyerukan Ashur sebagai sekutu yang kuat.
claims.quote: he was invoked often as a powerful ally by Assyrian kings

claims.statement: His depictions include a feather-robed archer riding a serpent or dragon.
claims.statement_id: Penggambarannya mencakup pemanah berjubah bulu yang menaiki ular atau naga.
claims.quote: He is often depicted as a feather-robed archer drawing a bow riding on a serpent or dragon.

claims.statement: Mackenzie notes Ashur sometimes being worshipped in other gods’ temples.
claims.statement_id: Mackenzie menyebut Ashur kadang dipuja dalam kuil dewa-dewa lain.
claims.quote: Ashur was sometimes worshipped in the temples of other gods.

claims.quote: Ereshkigal (also known as Irkalla and Allatu) is the Mesopotamian Queen of the Dead, who rules the underworld.

claims.quote: their children were Utu-Shamash (the sun god)

claims.statement: Adad is a Babylonian storm deity.
claims.statement_id: Adad adalah dewa badai Babilonia.
claims.quote: ADAD - The Babylonian god of storms

claims.statement: The Sumerians call him Ishkur.
claims.statement_id: Bangsa Sumeria menyebutnya Ishkur.
claims.quote: Known to the Sumerians as Ishkur

claims.statement: Adad is depicted with a lion-headed dragon or a bull.
claims.statement_id: Adad digambarkan bersama naga berkepala singa atau banteng.
claims.quote: he is depicted with a lion-headed dragon or a bull

claims.statement: Adad is depicted carrying a hammer or lightning bolt.
claims.statement_id: Adad digambarkan membawa palu atau petir.
claims.quote: carrying a hammer or lightning bolt.

claims.statement: Shala is named as Adad’s consort.
claims.statement_id: Shala disebut sebagai pasangan Adad.
claims.quote: His consort was the goddess Shala.

claims.statement: The account of Enlil’s family includes Ishkur, or Adad, as a weather deity.
claims.statement_id: Uraian keluarga Enlil memasukkan Ishkur atau Adad sebagai dewa cuaca.
claims.quote: the weather god Ishkur/Adad, and the love-goddess Inanna/Ishtar.

claims.statement: The hippocamp is a mythical creature combining a horse’s upper body and a fish’s lower body.
claims.statement_id: Hippocamp adalah makhluk mitos yang menggabungkan tubuh atas kuda dan tubuh bawah ikan.
claims.quote: typically depicted as having the upper body of a horse with the lower body of a fish.

claims.statement: Fourth-century BCE Tyrian coins depict Melqart riding a winged hippocamp.
claims.statement_id: Koin Tirus abad keempat SM menggambarkan Melqart menaiki hippocamp bersayap.
claims.quote: Coins minted at Tyre around the 4th century BC show the patron god Melqart riding on a winged hippocampus

claims.statement: A gold hippocamp from a Lydian hoard is dated to the sixth century BCE.
claims.statement_id: Hippocamp emas dari timbunan Lydia ditanggal sekitar abad keenam SM.
claims.quote: A gold hippocamp was discovered in a hoard from the kingdom of Lydia, Asia Minor, dating to the 6th century BC.

claims.statement: Hippokampoi are described as fish-tailed horses of the sea.
claims.statement_id: Hippokampoi digambarkan sebagai kuda laut berekor ikan.
claims.quote: HIPPOKAMPOI (Hippocamps) were the fish-tailed horses of the sea.

claims.statement: Their form combines a horse’s head and foreparts with a serpentine fish tail.
claims.statement_id: Bentuknya menggabungkan kepala dan bagian depan kuda dengan ekor ikan menyerupai ular.
claims.quote: They were depicted as composite creatures with the head and fore-parts of a horse and the serpentine-tail of a fish.

claims.statement: Mosaic art can give hippocamps green scales and fin-like manes and appendages.
claims.statement_id: Seni mosaik dapat memberi hippocamp sisik hijau serta surai dan anggota mirip sirip.
claims.quote: In mosaic art they were often had green scales and fish-fin manes and appendages.

claims.statement: According to the Theoi Project, hippokampoi were the mounts of Nereid nymphs and sea-gods, and Poseidon drove a chariot drawn by two or four of them.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Theoi Project, hippokampos menjadi tunggangan nimfa Nereid dan dewa laut, dan Poseidon mengendarai kereta yang ditarik dua atau empat ekor di antaranya.
claims.quote: Hippokampoi were the mounts of Nereid nymphs and sea-gods, and Poseidon drove a chariot drawn by two or four of the creatures.

claims.statement: In Philostratus's description of a painting, hippokampoi draw the chariot, creatures with web-footed hoofs, good swimmers, blue-eyed, and in all respects like dolphins.
claims.statement_id: Dalam uraian Philostratus tentang sebuah lukisan, hippokampos menarik kereta, makhluk berkuku berselaput, perenang yang baik, bermata biru, dan dalam segala hal mirip lumba-lumba.
claims.quote: here it is Hippokampoi (Hippocamps) that draw the chariot, creatures with web-footed hoofs, good swimmers, blue-eyed, and, by Zeus, in all respects like dolphins.

claims.statement: In Statius's Achilleid, Poseidon urges his team of hippokampoi with his three-pronged spear; the fronts run at furious speed amid foam, while the rears swim and blot out their footprints with their tails.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Achilleid karya Statius, Poseidon mendesak rombongan hippokampos dengan tombak bermata tiga; bagian depannya berlari dengan kecepatan buas di tengah percikan buih, bagian belakangnya berenang dan menghapus jejak dengan ekor.
claims.quote: He [Poseidon] towers on high above the peaceful waves, urging his team [of Hippokampoi (Hippocamps)] with his three-pronged spear: frontwise they run at furious speed amid showers of foam, behind they swim and blot out their footprints with their tails.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology as quoted by Theoi, the horse is Poseidon's symbol in the Homeric poems, his chariot is drawn over the sea's surface by swift horses, and later poets and artists depicted the horses of sea divinities as a horse-fish blend.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology yang dikutip Theoi, kuda adalah lambang Poseidon dalam puisi Homerik, kereta Poseidon ditarik kuda cepat di permukaan laut, dan penyair serta seniman kemudian menggambarkan kuda para dewa laut sebagai perpaduan kuda dan ikan.
claims.quote: The horse appears even in the Homeric poems as the symbol of Poseidon, whose chariot was drawn over the surface of the sea by swift horses. The later poets and artists conceived and represented the horses of Poseidon and other marine divinities as a combination of a horse and a fish.

claims.statement: According to the Theoi Project, the ancients believed hippokampoi were the adult form of the small fish we call the sea-horse.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Theoi Project, orang kuno percaya hippokampos adalah bentuk dewasa dari ikan kecil yang kini disebut kuda laut.
claims.quote: The ancients believed they were the adult-form of the small fish we call the "sea-horse".

claims.statement: According to this article, in Hellenistic and Roman imagery Poseidon often drives a sea-chariot drawn by hippocampi.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, dalam citra Hellenistik dan Romawi, Poseidon sering mengendarai kereta laut yang ditarik hippokampos.
claims.quote: In Hellenistic and Roman imagery, however, Poseidon often drives a "sea-chariot", drawn by hippocampi.

claims.statement: According to this article, Katharine Shepard found in the Etruscan hippocamp theme a belief in a sea-voyage to the other world.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, Katharine Shepard menemukan dalam tema hippokampos Etruria sebuah kepercayaan akan pelayaran menuju dunia lain.
claims.quote: Katharine Shepard found in the theme an Etruscan belief in a sea-voyage to the other world.
